intro.ar: الرّسول (- مَنْ قَرَأَ هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ وَ عَلَّمَهَا مَا مَلَکَتْ یَمِینُهُ مِنْ زَوْجَةٍ وَ غَیْرِهَا، أُعْطِیَ أَمَاناً مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَ مَنْ کَتَبَهَا فِی رَقِّ غَزَالٍ وَ جَعَلَهَا فِی حُقٍّ فِی مَنْزِلِهِ کَثُرَتْ إِلَیْهِ الْخُطَّابُ، طُلِبَ مِنْهُ التَّزْوِیجُ لِبَنَاتِهِ وَ أَخَوَاتِهِ وَ سَائِرِ قَرَابَاتِهِ وَ رَغِبَ کُلُّ أَحَدٍ إِلَیْهِ وَ لَوْ کَانَ صُعْلُوکاً فَقِیراً بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی. وَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ (مَنْ کَتَبَهَا فِی رَقِّ غَزَالٍ وَ تَرَکَهَا فِی حُقٍّ وَ عَلَّقَهَا فِی مَنْزِلِهِ کَثُرَتْ لَهُ الْخُطَّابُ لِحُرْمَتِهِ، وَ رَغِبَ إِلَیْهِمْ کُلُّ وَاحِدٍ وَ لَوْ کَانُوا فُقَرَاءَ.
intro.fa: پیامبر (- هرکس این سوره (سوره‌ی احزاب) را بخواند و آن را به افرادی که تحت حمایت او هستند - مانند همسر و دیگران - یاد بدهد، از عذاب قبر در امان می‌ماند و هرکس این سوره را بر روی پوست آهو نوشته و آن را درون حُقّهای، داخل منزل خود قرار دهد، به اذن خداوند، تعداد خواستگاران، نزد او افزایش می‌یابد و از او برای ازدواج با دختران، خواهران و سایر نزدیکان وی خواستگاری می‌کنند و همه کس به او میل پیدا می‌کنند، اگرچه او درویش و بینوا باشد. و در جایی دیگر فرمود: «هرکس، سوره‌ی احزاب را بر روی پوست آهو نوشته و آن را درون حُقّهای قرار داده و در منزل خود آویزان کند، تعداد خواستگاران برای خواستگاری از دختران خانواده وی افزایش می‌یابد و همه کس به آن‌ها میل پیدا می‌کنند، اگرچه درویش و بینوا باشند».
intro.en: The Messenger (pbuh) said: "Whoever recites this Surah and teaches it to those under his care, such as his wife and others, shall be granted security from the punishment of the grave. And whoever writes it on gazelle parchment and places it in a container within his home, the number of suitors coming to him will increase; he will be asked for the marriage of his daughters, sisters, and other relatives, and everyone will be drawn to him, even if he is a destitute pauper, by the permission of Allah the Exalted." And the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) also said: "Whoever writes it on gazelle parchment, leaves it in a container, and hangs it in his home, the number of suitors for his family will increase due to its sanctity, and everyone will be drawn to them, even if they are poor."
intro.refs: Al-Burhan / Nur al-Thaqalayn, in which it states: "And whoever writes it on gazelle parchment... until the end," [is] omitted.

intro.ar: الصّادق (- مَنْ کَتَبَهَا فِی رَقِّ ظَبْیٍ وَ جَعَلَهَا فِی مَنْزِلِهِ جَاءَتْ إِلَیْهِ الْخُطَّابُ فِی مَنْزِلِهِ وَ طُلِبَ التَّزْوِیجُ فِی بَنَاتِهِ وَ أَخَوَاتِهِ وَ جَمِیعِ أَهْلِهِ وَ أَقْرِبَائِهِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی.
intro.fa: امام صادق (- هرکس سوره‌ی احزاب را بر روی پوست آهو نوشته و آن را در منزل خود قرار دهد، به اذن خداوند تعداد خواستگارانی که به منزل آن مرد می‌آیند، افزایش می‌یابد و از او برای ازدواج با دختران، خواهران و سایر قبیله و نزدیکان وی، خواستگاری می‌کنند.
intro.en: Whoever writes it [Surah al-Ahzab] on gazelle parchment and places it in their home, suitors will come to their home, and marriage will be sought for their daughters, sisters, and all their family and relatives, by the permission of Allah the Exalted.

3.ar: الرّسول (- فِی مَجْمَعِ الْبَیَانِ: نَزَلَتْ فِی أَبِی سُفْیَانَ بْنِ حَرْبٍ وَ عِکْرِمَةَ بْنِ أَبِی جَهْلٍ وَ أَبِی الْأَعْوَرِ السُّلَمِیِّ قَدِمُوا الْمَدِینَةَ وَ نَزَلُوا عَلَی عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ أُبَیٍّ بَعْدَ غَزْوَةِ أُحُدٍ بِأَمَانٍ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ (لِیُکَلِّمُوهُ، فَقَامُوا وَ قَامَ مَعَهُمْ عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ أُبَیٍّ وَ عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ سَعِیدِ بْنِ أَبِی سَرْحٍ وَ طُعْمَةُ بْنُ أُبَیْرِقٍ فَدَخَلُوا عَلَی رَسُولِ اللهِ (فَقَالُوا: یَا مُحَمَّدُ (ارْفَضْ ذِکْرَ آلِهَتِنَا اللَّاتِ وَ الْعُزَّی وَ مَنَاةِ وَ قُلْ: إِنَّ لَهَا شَفَاعَةً لِمَنْ عَبَدَهَا وَ نَدَعُکَ وَ رَبَّکَ. فَشَقَّ ذَلِکَ عَلَی رَسُولِ اللهِ (فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: ائْذَنْ لَنَا یَا رَسُولَ اللهِ (فِی قَتْلِهِمْ. فَقَالَ: إِنِّی أَعْطَیْتُهُمُ الْأَمَانَ. وَ أَمَرَ (فَأُخْرِجُوا مِنَ الْمَدِینَةِ وَ نَزَلَتِ الْآیَةُ وَ لَا تُطِعِ الْکافِرِینَ مِنْ أَهْلِ مَکَّةَ: أَبَاسُفْیَانَ وَ أَبَا الْأَعْوَرِ وَ عِکْرِمَةَ، وَ الْمُنَافِقِینَ: ابْنَ أُبَیٍّ وَ ابْنَ سَعِیدٍ وَ طُعْمَةَ.
3.fa: پیامبر (- در تفسیر مجمع‌البیان آمده است: آیه‌ی شریفه در مورد ابوسفیان‌بن‌حرب و عکرمهًْ‌بن‌ابوجهل و ابی‌الاعور سلمی نازل شده که به مدینه رفتند و بعد از غزوه‌ی احد با امان نامه‌ی رسول خدا (بر عبدالله‌بن‌ابی وارد شدند تا با پیامبر (سخن گویند. پس درحالی‌که عبدالله‌بن‌ابی و عبدالله‌بن‌سعیدبن‌أبی سرح و طعمه‌بن‌ابیرق آن‌ها را همراهی می‌کردند بر پیامبر اسلام (وارد شده و گفتند: «ای محمّد بدگویی از خدایان ما؛ لات و عزّی و منات را ترک کن و بگو این‌ها نیز برای پیروان خویش شفاعت می‌نمایند و ما نیز تو را با خدایت تنها می‌گذاریم». این جسارت بر رسول خدا (سخت آمد. عمربن‌خطّاب گفت: «به ما اجازه بده این گروه را به قتل برسانیم». رسول خدا (فرمود: «من به آن‌ها امان می‌دهم». سپس امر نمود تا از مدینه خارج شوند و آیه‌ی شریفه‌ی وَ لا تُطِعِ الْکافِرینَ نازل شد که از اهل مکّه یعنی اباسفیان و اباالاعور و عکرمهًْ و المنافقین ابن‌ابی و ابن‌سعید و طعمه پیروی نکن.
3.en: In Majma' al-Bayan, it is stated: This verse was revealed regarding Abu Sufyan ibn Harb, 'Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl, and Abu al-A'war al-Sulami. They came to Medina after the Battle of Uhud, having been granted safe conduct by the Messenger of Allah (PBUH), to speak with him. They stood up, and Abdullah ibn Ubayy, Abdullah ibn Sa'd ibn Abi Sarh, and Tu'mah ibn Ubayriq joined them. They entered upon the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) and said, "O Muhammad, cease mentioning our gods—al-Lat, al-'Uzza, and Manat—and say that they have intercession for those who worship them, and we will leave you and your Lord alone." This was distressing to the Messenger of Allah (PBUH). Umar ibn al-Khattab said, "O Messenger of Allah, permit us to kill them." He replied, "I have granted them safe conduct." He then ordered them to be expelled from Medina, and the verse was revealed: "And do not obey the disbelievers" from the people of Mecca: Abu Sufyan, Abu al-A'war, and 'Ikrimah; "and the hypocrites": Ibn Ubayy, Ibn Sa'd, and Tu'mah.

3.ar: أمیرالمؤمنین (- إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی أَنْزَلَ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَی سَبْعَةِ أَقْسَام ... وَ مِنْهُ مُخَاطَبَةٌ لِلنَّبِیِّ (وَ مَعْنَاهُ وَاقِعٌ عَلَی أُمَّتِه ... وَ الْمُخَاطَبَةُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ الْمُرَادُ بِالْخِطَابِ الْأُمَّةُ وَ مِنْهُ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَی یا أَیُّهَا النَّبِیُّ إِذا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّساءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ یا أَیُّهَا النَّبِیُّ اتَّقِ اللهَ وَ لا تُطِعِ الْکافِرِینَ وَ الْمُنافِقِینَ وَ الْمُخَاطَبَةُ لَهُ وَ الْمُرَادُ بِالْخِطَابِ أُمَّتُه.
3.en: Verily, Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, revealed the Quran in seven divisions... Among them is the address to the Prophet, the meaning of which applies to his Ummah (community). The address is directed to the Messenger of Allah, but the intended meaning of the address is the Ummah. From this is His saying, the Exalted: "O Prophet! When you divorce women, divorce them for their prescribed waiting period," and "O Prophet! Fear Allah and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites." The address is to him, but the intended meaning of the address is his Ummah.
3.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 10

4.ar: الباقر (- عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَر (فِی قَوْلِهِ ما جَعَلَ اللهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَیْنِ فِی جَوْفِهِ فَیُحِبَّ بِهَذَا وَ یُبْغِضَ بِهَذَا فَأَمَّا مَحَبَّتُنَا (مُحِبُّنَا) فَیُخْلِصُ الْحُبَّ لَنَا کَمَا یَخْلُصُ الذَّهَبُ بِالنَّارِ لَا کَدَرَ فِیهِ مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ یَعْلَمَ حُبَّنَا فَلْیَمْتَحِنْ قَلْبَهُ فَإِنْ شَارَکَهُ فِی حُبِّنَا حُبَّ عَدُوِّنَا فَلَیْسَ مِنَّا وَ لَسْنَا مِنْهُ وَ اللَّهُ عَدُوُّهُمْ وَ جَبْرَئِیلُ وَ مِیکَائِیلُ وَ اللَّهُ عَدُوٌّ لِلْکَافِرِینَ.
4.fa: امام باقر (- در روایت ابوالجارود آمده است: امام باقر (پیرامون تفسیر آیه: ما جَعَلَ اللهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِّن قَلْبَیْنِ فِی جَوْفِهِ فرموده است: «خداوند عزّوجلّ در درون هیچ‌کس، دو قلب را قرار نداده که با یکی، کسی را دوست بدارد و با دیگری با او دشمنی ورزد. دوستدار ما چنان‌که زر با آتش خالص می‌گردد و هیچ‌گونه تیرگی و ناخالصی در آن نمی‌ماند، در دوستی با ما اخلاص می‌ورزد. پس هرکسی بخواهد بداند که از جمله دوستداران ما هست یا نه، باید قلب خود را بیازماید؛ اگر در دوستی و محبّت به ما، دشمن ما را نیز سهیم کند، او از ما نیست و ما نیز از او نیستیم. خداوند، جبرئیل (و میکائیل (دشمن او هستند و خداوند، دشمن کافران است.
4.en: Regarding the saying of Allah, "Allah has not made for any man two hearts in his breast," [meaning] that he would love with one and hate with the other. As for our lover, he purifies his love for us just as gold is purified by fire, with no impurity in it. Whoever wishes to know [the status of] our love should examine his own heart; if he shares his love for us with the love of our enemy, then he is not of us, and we are not of him. Allah, Gabriel, and Michael are enemies to them, and Allah is an enemy to the disbelievers.
4.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 27, p. 51; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 171; Al-Burhan

4.ar: الصّادق (- مَا جَعَلَ اللهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَیْنِ فِی جَوْفِهِ یُحِبُّ بِهَذَا قَوْماً وَ یُحِبُّ بِهَذَا أَعْدَائَهُمْ.
4.fa: امام صادق (- خداوند برای هیچ کس دودل در درونش نیافریده است که با یکی، گروهی را و با دیگری، دشمنان آن‌ها را دوست بدارد.
4.en: God has not placed two hearts within a man's chest, such that he would love one group with one [heart] and love their enemies with the other.
4.refs: Nur al-Thaqalayn/ Al-Burhan, in which it contains: "He loves one group with one... to the end" [which is] omitted.

4.via: Amir al-Mu'minin (Ali ibn Abi Talib) via Abu al-Jarud from Imam al-Sadiq (as)
4.ar: أمیرالمؤمنین (- عَنْ أَبِی الْجَارُود عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِاللَّهِ (فِی قَوْلِهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ ما جَعَلَ اللهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَیْنِ فِی جَوْفِهِ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (لَیْسَ عَبْدٌ مِنْ عَبِیدِ اللَّهِ مِمَّنِ امْتُحِنَ قَلْبُهُ لِلْإِیمَانِ إِلَّا وَ هُوَ یَجِدُ مَوَدَّتَنَا عَلَی قَلْبِهِ فَهُوَ یَوَدُّنَا وَ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ مِنْ عَبِیدِ اللَّهِ مِمَّنْ سَخِطَ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِ إِلَّا وَ هُوَ یَجِدُ بُغْضَنَا عَلَی قَلْبِهِ فَهُوَ یُبْغِضُنَا فَأَصْبَحْنَا نَفْرَحُ بِحُبِّ الْمُحِبِّ وَ نَعْرِفُ بُغْضَ الْمُبْغِضِ وَ أَصْبَحَ مُحِبُّنَا یَنْتَظِرُ رَحْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ فَکَأَنَّ أَبْوَابَ الرَّحْمَةِ قَدْ فُتِحَتْ لَهُ وَ أَصْبَحَ مُبْغِضُنَا عَلَی شَفَا جُرُفٍ مِنَ النَّارِ فَکَأَنَّ ذَلِکَ الشَّفَا قَدِ انْهَارَ بِهِ فِی نارِ جَهَنَّمَ فَهَنِیئاً لِأَهْلِ الرَّحْمَةِ رَحْمَتُهُمْ وَ تَعْساً لِأَهْلِ النَّارِ مَثْوَاهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ یَقُولُ فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَی الْمُتَکَبِّرِینَ وَ إِنَّهُ لَیْسَ عَبْدٌ مِنْ عَبِیدِ اللَّهِ یُقَصِّرُ فِی حُبِّنَا لِخَیْرٍ جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ إِذْ لَا یَسْتَوِی مَنْ یُحِبُّنَا وَ مَنْ یُبْغِضُنَا وَ لَا یَجْتَمِعَانِ فِی قَلْبِ رَجُلٍ أَبَداً إِنَّ اللهَ لَمْ یَجْعَلْ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَیْنِ فِی جَوْفِهِ یُحِبُّ بِهَذَا وَ یُبْغِضُ بِهَذَا أَمَّا مُحِبُّنَا فَیُخْلِصُ الْحُبَّ لَنَا کَمَا یَخْلُصُ الذَّهَبُ بِالنَّارِ لَا کَدَرَ فِیهِ وَ مُبْغِضُنَا عَلَی تِلْکَ الْمَنْزِلَةِ نَحْنُ النُّجَبَاءُ وَ أَفْرَاطُنَا أَفْرَاطُ الْأَنْبِیَاءِ وَ أَنَا وَصِیُّ الْأَوْصِیَاءِ وَ الْفِئَةُ الْبَاغِیَةُ مِنْ حِزْبِ الشَّیْطَانِ وَ الشَّیْطَانُ مِنْهُمْ فَمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ یَعْلَمَ حُبَّنَا فَلْیَمْتَحِنْ قَلْبَهُ فَإِنْ شَارَکَ فِی حُبِّنَا عَدُوَّنَا فَلَیْسَ مِنَّا وَ لَسْنَا مِنْهُ وَ اللَّهُ عَدُوُّهُ وَ جَبْرَئِیلُ (وَ مِیکَائِیلُ وَ اللَّهُ عَدُوٌّ لِلْکَافِرِینَ.
4.en: Regarding the saying of the Almighty, "Allah has not made for any man two hearts in his breast," Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "There is no servant among the servants of Allah whose heart has been tested for faith, but that he finds our love in his heart, and thus he loves us. And there is no servant among the servants of Allah with whom Allah is displeased, but that he finds our hatred in his heart, and thus he hates us. We rejoice at the love of the one who loves us, and we recognize the hatred of the one who hates us. The one who loves us awaits the mercy of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, as if the gates of mercy have been opened for him. The one who hates us is on the edge of a crumbling pit of fire, as if that edge has collapsed with him into the fire of Hell. So, congratulations to the people of mercy for their mercy, and woe to the people of the Fire for their abode. Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, says: 'And how evil is the abode of the arrogant.' There is no servant among the servants of Allah who falls short in our love due to some good that Allah has placed within him, for the one who loves us and the one who hates us are not equal, and they can never coexist in the heart of a man. 'Allah has not made for any man two hearts in his breast'—loving with one and hating with the other. As for the one who loves us, he purifies his love for us just as gold is purified by fire, with no impurity in it; and the one who hates us is in that same state [of purity in his hatred]. We are the noble ones (al-Nujaba), and our descendants are the descendants of the Prophets, and I am the successor of the successors (Wasi al-Awsiya). The rebellious faction is from the party of Satan, and Satan is among them. So whoever wishes to know [the status of] our love, let him examine his heart; if he associates the love of our enemy with the love for us, then he is not of us, and we are not of him, and Allah, Gabriel, and Michael are his enemies. And Allah is the enemy of the disbelievers."
4.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 317; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 27, p. 83; Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahira, p. 439; al-Burhan.

4.ar: أمیرالمؤمنین (- ٍعَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ مِیثَمٍ التَّمَّارِ قَالَ: وَجَدْتُ فِی کِتَابِ مِیثَمٍ یَقُولُ تَمَسَّیْنَا لَیْلَةً عِنْدَ أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ عَلِیِّ بْنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (فَقَالَ لَنَا ... إِنَّ عَبْداً لَنْ یَقْصُرَ فِی حُبِّنَا لِخَیْرٍ جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ فِی قَلْبِهِ وَ لَنْ یُحِبَّنَا مَنْ یُحِبُّ مُبْغِضَنَا إِنَّ ذَلِکَ لَا یَجْتَمِعُ فِی قَلْبٍ وَاحِدٍ ما جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَیْنِ یُحِبُّ بِهَذَا قَوْماً وَ یُحِبُّ بِالْآخَرِ عَدُوَّهُمْ وَ الَّذِی یُحِبُّنَا فَهُوَ یُخْلِصُ حُبَّنَا کَمَا یُخْلِصُ الذَّهَبَ لَا غِشَّ فِیه.
4.fa: امام علی (- صالح‌بن‌میثم تمّار گوید: در کتاب میثم (چنین دیدم که گفته بود: شبی در محضر امیرالمؤمنین (بودم به ما فرمود: «بنده‌ای که در محبّت ما کوتاهی نمی‌کند؛ بهترین چیز را در قلب خویش جای داده است و هرکس دشمنان ما را دوست بدارد از دوستاران ما نیست. به خاطر اینکه دو محبّت در یک قلب جمع نمی‌شود و خداوند برای یک فرد دو قلب قرار نداده است که با این قلب فردی را دوست داشته باشد و با قلب دیگر دشمنش را دوست داشته باشد و کسی که محبّت ما را به دل دارد، باید آن را خالص گرداند همان‌گونه که طلا را خالص و بدون غش قرار می‌دهد».
4.en: Salih ibn Maytham al-Tammar said: I found in the book of Maytham that he said: We spent an evening in the presence of the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), and he said to us: "A servant will never fall short in loving us for the sake of the good that Allah has placed in his heart, and one who loves our enemy will never love us. Indeed, these two cannot coexist in one heart; Allah has not placed two hearts in the chest of any man, such that he loves one group with one heart and loves their enemy with the other. He who loves us must purify his love for us, just as gold is purified, with no impurity in it."
4.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 27, p. 83; Nur al-Thaqalayn

4.ar: الصّادق (- فَمَنْ کَانَ قَلْبَهُ مُتَعَلِّقاً فِی صَلَاتِهِ بِشَیْءٍ دُونَ اللَّهِ فَهُوَ قَرِیبٌ مِنْ ذَلِکَ الشَّیْءِ بَعِیدٌ عَنْ حَقِیقَةِ مَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ فِی صَلَاتِهِ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی ما جَعَلَ اللهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَیْنِ فِی جَوْفِهِ.
4.fa: امام صادق (- پس کسی که در حال نماز قلب او متعلّق به غیر خداوند شد، هر آینه نزدیک به آن چیز شده و از حقیقت آنچه در حال نماز مقصود و مطلوب است، دور خواهد شد. خداوند متعال می‌فرماید: ما جَعَلَ اللهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَیْنِ فِی جَوْفِهِ.
4.en: Whoever has their heart attached to something other than God during their prayer is close to that thing and far from the reality of what God intended for them in their prayer. God Almighty says: "God has not made for any man two hearts in his breast."
4.refs: Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 4, p. 482; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 82, p. 136; Misbah al-Shari'ah, p. 91

4.ar: الرّسول (- قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ لَا أَطَّلِعُ عَلَی قَلْبِ عَبْدٍ فَأَعْلَمَ مِنْهُ حُبَّ الْإِخْلَاصِ لِطَاعَتِی لِوَجْهِی وَ ابْتِغَاءِ مَرْضَاتِی إِلَّا تَوَلَّیْتُ تَقْوِیمَهُ وَ سِیَاسَتَهُ وَ مَنِ اشْتَغَلَ فِی صَلَاتِهِ بِغَیْرِی فَهُوَ مِنَ الْمُسْتَهْزِءِینَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَ مَکْتُوبٌ اسْمُهُ فِی دِیوَانِ الْخَاسِرِینَ.
4.fa: پیامبر (- رسول اکرم (می‌فرماید: خداوند متعال می‌فرماید، چون اطّلاع پیدا کنم به قلب کسی که محبّت خالص و علاقه‌ی جدّی به عبادت و طاعت من داشته و تنها نیّت و مقصد او تحصیل رضا و بدست آوردن مقام بندگی است هر آینه خودم به سیاست و تنظیم امور او مباشرت کرده و به او نزدیک می‌شوم و اگر کسی در حال نماز به غیر من مشغول باشد؛ پس او از استهزاکنندگان بوده و نام او در دفتر خسارت‌کاران ثبت خواهد شد.
4.en: The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: Allah the Almighty says: "I do not look into the heart of a servant and find therein sincere love for My obedience for My sake and for the seeking of My pleasure, except that I take charge of his rectification and his governance. And whoever is occupied with other than Me during his prayer, he is among those who mock themselves, and his name is written in the register of the losers."
4.refs: Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 4, p. 482; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 82, p. 136; Misbah al-Shari'ah, p. 91

4.ar: أمیرالمؤمنین (- إِنَّمَا هُوَ حَقٌّ وَ بَاطِلٌ وَ إِیمَانٌ وَ کُفْرٌ وَ عِلْمٌ وَ جَهْلٌ وَ سَعَادَةٌ وَ شِقْوَةٌ وَ جَنَّةٌ وَ نَارٌ لَنْ یَجْتَمِعَ الْحَقُّ وَ الْبَاطِلُ فِی قَلْبِ امْرِئٍ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی ما جَعَلَ اللهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَیْنِ فِی جَوْفِهِ وَ إِنَّمَا هَلَکَ النَّاسُ حِینَ سَاوَوْا بَیْنَ أَئِمَّةِ الْهُدَی وَ بَیْنَ أَئِمَّةِ الْکُفْرِ وَ قَالُوا إِنَّ الطَّاعَةَ مَفْرُوضَةٌ لِکُلِّ مَنْ قَامَ مَقَامَ النَّبِیِّ (بَرّاً کَانَ أَوْ فَاجِراً فَأْتُوا مِنْ قِبَلِ ذَلِک.
4.fa: امام علی (- در دنیا حقّ و باطل، ایمان و کفر، علم و جهل، سعادت و شقاوت و بهشت و دوزخ به هم آمیخته و حقّ و باطل در دل هیچ انسانی جمع نمی‌گردند و خداوند در کتاب خود فرموده است: ما جَعَلَ اللهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَیْنِ فِی جَوْفِهِ مردم هنگامی هلاک شدند که بین رهبران حقّ و کفر فرقی قائل نشدند و همه را یکسان دانستند و گفتند: «هرکس که در جای رسول اکرم (نشست اطاعتش واجب می‌باشد خواه نیکوکار و یا بدکار باشند و از همین‌جا هلاک شدند».
4.en: It is only truth and falsehood, faith and disbelief, knowledge and ignorance, felicity and wretchedness, and Paradise and Hell. Truth and falsehood will never gather in the heart of a person. Allah the Exalted said: "Allah has not made for any man two hearts in his breast." People only perished when they equated the leaders of guidance with the leaders of disbelief, and said, "Obedience is mandatory for everyone who takes the place of the Prophet, whether they are righteous or wicked." It is from this that they met their ruin.
4.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 14
4.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 66, p. 82; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 90, p. 57

4.ar: أمیرالمؤمنین (- عَنْ جَیْشِ بْنِ الْمُعْتَمِرِ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَی أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ عَلِیِّ بْنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (وَ هُوَ فِی الرَّحْبَةِ مُتَّکِئٌ فَقُلْتُ السَّلَامُ عَلَیْکَ یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (وَ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَ بَرَکَاتُهُ کَیْفَ أَصْبَحْتَ قَالَ فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ وَ رَدَّ عَلَیَّ وَ قَالَ أَصْبَحْتُ مُحِبّاً لِمُحِبِّنَا مُبْغِضاً لِمَنْ یُبْغِضُنَا إِنَّ مُحِبَّنَا یَنْتَظِرُ الرَّوْحَ وَ الْفَرَجَ فِی کُلِّ یَوْمٍ وَ لَیْلَةٍ وَ إِنَّ مُبْغِضَنَا بَنَی بِنَاءً فَأَسَّسَ بُنْیانَهُ عَلی شَفا جُرُفٍ هارٍ فَکَأَنَّ بُنْیَانَهُ هَارٍ فَانْهارَ بِهِ فِی نارِ جَهَنَّمَ یَا أَبَا الْمُعْتَمِرِ إِنَّ مُحِبَّنَا لَا یَسْتَطِیعُ أَنْ یُبْغِضَنَا قَالَ وَ مُبْغِضُنَا لَا یَسْتَطِیعُ أَنْ یُحِبَّنَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی جَبَلَ قُلُوبَ الْعِبَادِ عَلَی حُبِّنَا وَ خَذَلَ مَنْ یُبْغِضُنَا فَلَنْ یَسْتَطِیعَ مُحِبُّنَا یُبْغِضُنَا وَ لَنْ یَسْتَطِیعَ مُبْغِضُنَا یُحِبُّنَا وَ لَنْ یَجْتَمِعَ حُبُّنَا وَ حُبُّ عَدُوِّنَا فِی قَلْبِ أَحَدٍ ما جَعَلَ اللهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَیْنِ فِی جَوْفِهِ یُحِبُّ بِهَذَا قَوْماً وَ یُحِبُّ بِالْآخَرِ أَعْدَاءَهُمْ.
4.fa: امام علی (- جیش‌بن‌معتمر گوید: در محلّه‌ی رحبه (نام محلّه‌ی در کوفه) بر امیرالمؤمنین علی (وارد شدم، درحالی‌که آن حضرت به‌جایی تکیه فرموده بود، من بعد از سلام و عرض ارادت پرسیدم: «آقا چگونه صبح کردی»؟ امیرالمؤمنین (سرش را بلند کرد و پس از پاسخ سلام من فرمود: «صبح کردم درحالی‌که با دوستان خود دوست و با دشمنان خود دشمن هستم، دوستان ما هر لحظه چشم به راه راحتی و گشایش است. امّا دشمنان ما پایه و اساسی ندارند و آن‌ها در کنار گور و گودال‌ها زندگی می‌کنند و به‌زودی در آتش جهنّم سقوط می‌نمایند. ای ابومعتمر! دوستان ما توانایی ندارند با ما دشمنی کنند و دشمنان ما هم نمی‌توانند با ما دوست باشند، خداوند متعال دل‌های بندگان را بر محبّت ما آفریده و دشمنان را وانهاده! پس هرگز دوست ما توانایی دشمنی ما را ندارد و هرگز دشمن ما قدرت بر دوستی ما نخواهد داشت و هرگز دوستی ما و دوستی دشمنان ما در یک دل جمع نمی‌گردد؛ ما جَعَلَ اللهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَیْنِ فِی جَوْفِهِ که با یک دل گروهی را دوست بدارد و با دلی دیگر دشمنان آن‌ها را دوست بدارد».
4.en: Jaish ibn al-Mu'tamir said: I entered upon the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), while he was in the Rahbah, reclining. I said, "Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. How have you spent your morning?" He raised his head, returned my greeting, and said, "I have spent my morning loving those who love us and hating those who hate us. Indeed, those who love us await relief and deliverance every day and night. As for those who hate us, they have built a structure, and they have founded their building on the edge of a crumbling bank, so it is as if their building is crumbling, and it will collapse with them into the fire of Hell. O Aba al-Mu'tamir, those who love us cannot hate us, and those who hate us cannot love us. Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, has fashioned the hearts of the servants upon our love and has forsaken those who hate us. Thus, one who loves us will never be able to hate us, and one who hates us will never be able to love us. Our love and the love of our enemy will never gather in the heart of any person; 'Allah has not made for any man two hearts in his breast,' that he should love one group with one heart and love their enemies with the other."
4.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 14

4.ar: الصّادق (- کَانَ سَبَبَ ذَلِکَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (لَمَّا تَزَوَّجَ بِخَدِیجَةَ بِنْتِ خُوَیْلِدٍ خَرَجَ إِلَی سُوقِ عُکَاظٍ فِی تِجَارَةٍ لَهَا وَ رَأَی زَیْداً یُبَاعُ وَ رَآهُ غُلَاماً کَیِّساً حَصِیفاً فَاشْتَرَاهُ فَلَمَّا نُبِّئَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (دَعَاهُ إِلَی الْإِسْلَامِ فَأَسْلَمَ فَکَانَ یُدْعَی زَیْدٌ مَوْلَی مُحَمَّدٍ (فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ حَارِثَةَ بْنَ شَرَاحِیلَ الْکَلْبِیَّ خَبَرُ زَیْدٍ قَدِمَ مَکَّةَ وَ کَانَ رَجُلًا جَلِیلًا فَأَتَی أَبَاطَالِبٍ فَقَالَ یَا أَبَاطَالِبٍ إِنَّ ابْنِی وَقَعَ عَلَیْهِ السَّبْیُ وَ بَلَغَنِی أَنَّهُ صَارَ لِابْنِ أَخِیکَ تَسْأَلُهُ إِمَّا أَنْ یَبِیعَهُ وَ إِمَّا أَنْ یُفَادِیَهُ وَ إِمَّا أَنْ یُعْتِقَهُ فَکَلَّمَ أَبُوطَالِبٍ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (هُوَ حُرٌّ فَلْیَذْهَبْ حَیْثُ شَاءَ فَقَامَ حَارِثَةُ فَأَخَذَ بِیَدِ زَیْدٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ یَا بُنَیَّ الْحَقْ بِشَرَفِکَ وَ حَسَبِکَ فَقَالَ زَیْدٌ لَسْتُ أُفَارِقُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (أَبَداً فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُوهُ فَتَدَعُ حَسَبَکَ وَ نَسَبَکَ وَ تَکُونُ عَبْداً لِقُرَیْشٍ فَقَالَ زَیْدٌ لَسْتُ أُفَارِقُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (مَا دُمْتُ حَیّاً فَغَضِبَ أَبُوهُ فَقَالَ یَا مَعْشَرَ قُرَیْشٍ اشْهَدُوا أَنِّی قَدْ بَرِئْتُ مِنْهُ وَ لَیْسَ هُوَ ابْنِی فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (اشْهَدُوا أَنَّ زَیْداً ابْنِی أَرِثُهُ وَ یَرِثُنِی وَ کَانَ یُدْعَی زَیْدَبْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ کَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (یُحِبُّهُ وَ سَمَّاهُ زَیْدَ الْحُبِّ فَلَمَّا هَاجَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (إِلَی الْمَدِینَةِ زَوَّجَهُ زَیْنَبَ بِنْتَ جَحْشٍ وَ أَبْطَأَ عَنْهُ یَوْماً فَأَتَی رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (مَنْزِلَهُ یَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ فَإِذَا زَیْنَبُ جَالِسَةٌ وَسَطَ حُجْرَتِهَا تَسْحَقُ طِیباً بِفِهْرٍ لَهَا فَدَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (الْبَابَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَیْهَا وَ کَانَتْ جَمِیلَةً حَسَنَةً فَقَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ خَالِقِ النُّورِ وَ تَبَارَکَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخالِقِینَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ (إِلَی مَنْزِلِهِ وَ وَقَعَتْ زَیْنَبُ فِی قَلْبِهِ وُقُوعاً عَجِیباً وَ جَاءَ زَیْدٌ إِلَی مَنْزِلِهِ فَأَخْبَرَتْهُ زَیْنَبُ بِمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (فَقَالَ لَهَا زَیْدٌ هَلْ لَکِ أَنْ أُطَلِّقَکِ حَتَّی یَتَزَوَّجَکِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (فَعَلَّکِ قَدْ وَقَعْتِ فِی قَلْبِهِ فَقَالَتْ أَخْشَی أَنْ تُطَلِّقَنِی وَ لَا یَتَزَوَّجَنِی رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (فَجَاءَ زَیْدٌ إِلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فَقَالَ بِأَبِی أَنْتَ وَ أُمِّی أَخْبَرَتْنِی زَیْنَبُ بِکَذَا وَ کَذَا فَهَلْ لَکَ أَنْ أُطَلِّقَهَا حَتَّی تَتَزَوَّجَهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (لَا اذْهَبْ وَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَ أَمْسِکْ عَلَیْکَ زَوْجَکَ ثُمَّ حَکَی اللَّهُ فَقَالَ أَمْسِکْ عَلَیْکَ زَوْجَکَ وَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَ تُخْفِی فِی نَفْسِکَ مَا اللَّهُ مُبْدِیهِ وَ تَخْشَی النَّاسَ وَ اللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ تَخْشاهُ فَلَمَّا قَضی زَیْدٌ مِنْها وَطَراً زَوَّجْناکَها إِلَی قَوْلِهِ وَ کانَ أَمْرُ اللهِ مَفْعُولًا فَزَوَّجَهُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَوْقِ عَرْشِهِ فَقَالَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ یُحَرِّمُ عَلَیْنَا نِسَاءَنَا وَ یَتَزَوَّجُ امْرَأَةَ ابْنِهِ زَیْدٍ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِی هَذَا وَ ما جَعَلَ أَدْعِیاءَکُمْ أَبْناءَکُمْ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ یَهْدِی السَّبِیلَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ادْعُوهُمْ لِآبائِهِمْ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ وَ مَوالِیکُمْ فَأَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ أَنَّ زَیْداً لَیْسَ هُوَ ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ (وَ إِنَّمَا ادَّعَاهُ لِلسَّبَبِ الَّذِی ذَکَرْنَاهُ وَ فِی هَذَا أَیْضاً مَا نَکْتُبُهُ فِی غَیْرِ هَذَا الْمَوْضِعِ فِی قَوْلِهِ ما کانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبا أَحَدٍ مِنْ رِجالِکُمْ وَ لکِنْ رَسُولَ اللهِ وَ خاتَمَ النَّبِیِّینَ وَ کانَ اللهُ بِکُلِّ شَیْءٍ عَلِیماً ثُمَّ نَزَلَ لا یَحِلُّ لَکَ النِّساءُ بَعْدَ مَا حَرَّمَ عَلَیْهِ فِی سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ وَ قَوْلُهُ وَ لا أَنْ تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنْ أَزْواجٍ مَعْطُوفٌ عَلَی قِصَّةِ امْرَأَةِ زَیْدٍ وَ لَوْ أَعْجَبَکَ حُسْنُهُنَّ أَیْ لَا یَحِلُّ لَکَ امْرَأَةُ رَجُلٍ أَنْ تَتَعَرَّضَ لَهَا حَتَّی یُطَلِّقَهَا وَ تَتَزَوَّجَهَا أَنْتَ فَلَا تَفْعَلْ هَذَا الْفِعْلَ بَعْدَ هَذَا.
4.en:
The cause of this was that when the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) married Khadija bint Khuwaylid, he went to the Ukaz market for her trade. There, he saw Zayd being sold and, finding him to be a clever and prudent youth, he purchased him. When the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) was commissioned with Prophethood, he invited Zayd to Islam, and he accepted. Zayd was then called "the freedman of Muhammad." When the news of Zayd reached his father, Harithah ibn Sharahil al-Kalbi—who was a man of high standing—he came to Mecca and went to Abu Talib. He said, "O Abu Talib, my son was taken captive, and I have heard that he is now with your nephew. I ask him to either sell him to me, accept a ransom for him, or set him free." Abu Talib spoke to the Messenger of Allah (PBUH), who replied, "He is free; he may go wherever he wishes." Harithah stood up, took Zayd by the hand, and said, "O my son, return to your honor and your lineage." Zayd replied, "I will never leave the Messenger of Allah (PBUH)." His father said, "Will you abandon your lineage and status to remain a slave to the Quraysh?" Zayd replied, "I will not leave the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) as long as I live." His father became angry and said, "O people of Quraysh, bear witness that I disown him and he is no longer my son." The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) then said, "Bear witness that Zayd is my son; I shall inherit from him and he shall inherit from me." He was then called Zayd ibn Muhammad, and the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) loved him and named him Zayd al-Hubb (Zayd the Beloved).

When the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) migrated to Medina, he married Zayd to Zaynab bint Jahsh. One day, Zayd was delayed, so the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) went to his house to ask about him. Zaynab was sitting in the middle of her room, grinding perfume with her hand-mill. The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) pushed the door open and looked at her; she was beautiful and fair. He said, "Glory be to Allah, the Creator of light, and Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators." He then returned to his home, and Zaynab had made a strange impression upon his heart. When Zayd returned home, Zaynab told him what the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) had said. Zayd said to her, "Would you like me to divorce you so that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) may marry you? Perhaps you have entered his heart." She replied, "I fear that you might divorce me and the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) might not marry me." Zayd went to the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) and said, "May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, Zaynab told me such and such. Would you like me to divorce her so that you may marry her?" The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said to him, "No, go, fear Allah, and keep your wife." Then Allah revealed: "Keep your wife and fear Allah, and you were concealing within yourself what Allah was to disclose, and you were fearing the people, while Allah has more right that you fear Him." When Zayd had accomplished his desire from her, We married her to you... up to His saying: "And the command of Allah is ever done." Thus, Allah married her to him from above His Throne. The hypocrites said, "He forbids us our wives, yet he marries the wife of his son Zayd!" So Allah revealed: "And He has not made your adopted sons your [true] sons..." up to His saying: "He guides to the [right] way." Then He said: "Call them by [the names of] their fathers..." up to His saying: "And your brothers in religion and your allies." Thus, Allah made it known that Zayd was not the son of Muhammad (PBUH), and that he had only claimed him as such for the reason we mentioned. Regarding this, there is also what we have written elsewhere concerning His saying: "Muhammad is not the father of [any] one of your men, but [he is] the Messenger of Allah and last of the prophets. And ever is Allah, of all things, Knowing." Then was revealed: "Not lawful to you, [O Muhammad], are [any additional] women after [this]..." (in Surah al-Nisa), and His saying: "Nor [is it] for you to take other wives in exchange for them," which is connected to the story of Zayd's wife, "even if their beauty were to please you." This means: It is not lawful for you to approach the wife of another man until he divorces her and you marry her; do not do this act after this.
4.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 22, p. 214; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 172; Al-Burhan.

4.ar: أمیرالمؤمنین (- فی تفسیر الإمام (: لَقَدْ مَرَّ أَمِیرُالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (عَلَی قَوْمٍ مِنْ أَخْلَاطِ الْمُسْلِمِینَ لَیْسَ فِیهِمْ مُهَاجِرِیٌّ وَ لَا أَنْصَارِیٌّ ... فقال (لَقَدْ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (جَیْشاً ذَاتَ یَوْمٍ إِلَی قَوْمٍ مِنْ أَشِدَّاءِ الْکُفَّارِ فَأَبْطَأَ عَلَیْهِمْ خَبَرُهُمْ وَ تَعَلَّقَ قَلْبُهُ بِهِمْ وَ قَالَ لَیْتَ لَنَا مَنْ یَتَعَرَّفُ أَخْبَارَهُمْ وَ یَأْتِینَا بِأَنْبَائِهِمْ بَیْنَا هُوَ قَائِلُ هَذَا إِذْ جَاءَهُ الْبَشِیرُ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَدْ ظَفِرُوا بِأَعْدَائِهِمْ وَ اسْتَوْلَوْا وَ صَیَّرُوا بَیْنَ قَتِیلٍ وَ جَرِیحٍ وَ أَسِیرٍ وَ انْتَهَبُوا أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَ سَبَوْا ذَرَارِیَّهُمْ وَ عِیَالَهُمْ فَلَمَّا قَرُبَ الْقَوْمُ مِنَ الْمَدِینَةِ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (بِأَصْحَابِهِ یَتَلَقَّاهُمْ فَلَمَّا لَقِیَهُمْ وَ رَئِیسُهُمْ زَیْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ وَ کَانَ قَدْ أَمَّرَهُ عَلَیْهِمْ فَلَمَّا رَأَی زَیْدٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (نَزَلَ عَنْ نَاقَتِهِ وَ جَاءَ إِلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ قَبَّلَ رِجْلَهُ ثُمَّ قَبَّلَ یَدَهُ فَأَخَذَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (وَ قَبَّلَ رَأْسَهُ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ إِلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَوَاحَةَ فَقَبَّلَ رِجْلَهُ وَ یَدَهُ وَ ضَمَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (إِلَیْهِ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ إِلَیْهِ قَیْسُ بْنُ عَاصِمٍ الْمِنْقَرِیُّ فَقَبَّلَ یَدَهُ وَ رِجْلَهُ وَ ضَمَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (إِلَیْهِ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ إِلَیْهِ سَائِرُ الْجَیْشِ وَ وَقَفُوا یُصَلُّونَ عَلَیْهِ وَ رَدَّ عَلَیْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (خَیْراً ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُمْ حَدِّثُونِی خَبَرَکُمْ وَ حَالَکُمْ مَعَ أَعْدَائِکُم ... قالوا زَحَفْنَا إِلَیْهِمْ فَدَخَلْنَا بَلَدَهُمْ وَ أَغْلَقُوا دُونَنَا بَابَهُ فَقَعَدْنَا نُنَازِلُهُمْ فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَیْنَا اللَّیْلُ وَ صِرْنَا إِلَی نِصْفِهِ فَتَحُوا بَابَ بَلَدِهِمْ وَ نَحْنُ غَارُّونَ نَائِمُونَ مَا کَانَ فِینَا مُنْتَبِهٌ إِلَّا أَرْبَعَةُ نَفَرٍ زَیْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ فِی جَانِبٍ مِنْ جَوَانِبِ عَسْکَرِنَا یُصَلِّی وَ یَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَوَاحَةَ فِی جَانِبٍ آخَرَ یُصَلِّی وَ یَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَ قَتَادَةُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ فِی جَانِبٍ آخَرَ یُصَلِّی وَ یَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَ قَیْسُ بْنُ عَاصِمٍ فِی جَانِبٍ آخَرَ یُصَلِّی وَ یَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ فَخَرَجُوا فِی اللَّیْلَةِ الظَّلْمَاءِ الدَّامِسَةِ وَ رَشَقُونَا بِنِبَالِهِمْ وَ کَانَ ذَلِکَ بَلَدَهُمْ وَ هُمْ بِطُرُقِهِ وَ مَوَاضِعِهِ عَالِمُونَ وَ نَحْنُ بِهَا جَاهِلُونَ فَقُلْنَا فِیمَا بَیْنَنَا دُهِینَا وَ أُوتِ-ینَا هَذَا لَیْلٌ مُظْلِمٌ لَا یُمْکِنُنَا أَنْ نَتَّقِیَ النِّبَالَ لِأَنَّا لَا نُبْصِرُهَا فَبَیْنَا نَحْنُ کَذَلِکَ إِذْ رَأَیْنَا ضَوْءاً خَارِجاً مِنْ فِی قَیْسِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ الْمِنْقَرِیِّ کَالنَّارِ الْمُشْتَعِلَةِ وَ ضَوْءاً خَارِجاً مِنْ فِی قَتَادَةَ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ کَضَوْءِ الزُّهْرَةِ وَ الْمُشْتَرِی وَ ضَوْءاً خَارِجاً مِنْ فِی عَبْدِاللَّهِ بْنِ رَوَاحَةَ کَشُعَاعِ الْقَمَرِ فِی اللَّیْلَةِ الْمُظْلِمَةِ وَ نُوراً سَاطِعاً مِنْ فِی زَیْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ أَضْوَأَ مِنَ الشَّمْسِ الطَّالِعَةِ ... قال (أَمَّا زَیْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ الَّذِی کَانَ یَخْرُجُ مِنْ فِیهِ نُورٌ أَضْوَأُ مِنَ الشَّمْسِ الطَّالِعَةِ وَ هُوَ سَیِّدُ الْقَوْمِ وَ أَفْضَلُهُمْ فَلَقَدْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ مَا یَکُونُ مِنْهُ فَاخْتَارَهُ وَ فَضَّلَهُ عَلَی عِلْمِهِ بِمَا یَکُونُ مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ فِی الْیَوْمِ الَّذِی وَلِیَ هَذِهِ اللَّیْلَةَ الَّتِی کَانَ فِیهَا ظَفَرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ بِالشَّمْسِ الطَّالِعَةِ مِنْ فِیهِ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ مُنَافِقِی عَسْکَرِهِمْ یُرِیدُ التَّضْرِیبَ بَیْنَهُ وَ بَیْنَ عَلِیِّ بْنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (وَ إِفْسَادَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا فَقَالَ لَهُ بَخْ بَخْ لَکَ لَا نَظِیرَ لَکَ فِی أَهْلِ بَیْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ صَحَابَتِهِ هَذَا بَلَاؤُکَ وَ هَذَا الَّذِی شَاهَدْنَاهُ نُورُکَ فَقَالَ لَهُ زَیْدٌ یَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَ لَا تُفْرِطْ فِی الْمَقَالِ وَ لَا تَرْفَعْنِی فَوْقَ قَدْرِی فَإِنَّکَ لِلَّهِ بِذَلِکَ مُخَالِفٌ وَ بِهِ کَافِرٌ وَ إِنِّی إِنْ تَلَقَّیْتُ مَقَالَتَکَ هَذِهِ بِالْقَبُولِ لَکُنْتُ 4.en: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) passed by a group of Muslims among whom there were neither Muhajirun (emigrants) nor Ansar (helpers)... He said: "One day, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sent an army to a group of fierce disbelievers. News of them was delayed, and his heart became attached to them. He said, 'I wish we had someone who could inquire about their news and bring us their reports.' While he was saying this, a bearer of good news came to him, announcing that they had triumphed over their enemies, seized them, and left them either killed, wounded, or captured, and that they had plundered their wealth and taken their children and families captive. When the group approached Medina, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) went out with his companions to meet them. When he met them, their leader was Zayd ibn Harithah, whom he had appointed over them. When Zayd saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), he dismounted from his camel, came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and kissed his feet, then kissed his hand. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) took him and kissed his head. Then Abdullah ibn Rawahah came down to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and kissed his feet and hand, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) embraced him. Then Qays ibn Asim al-Minqari came down to him and kissed his hand and feet, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) embraced him. Then the rest of the army dismounted and stood praying for him, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) responded to them with goodness. Then he said to them, 'Tell me your news and your situation with your enemies...' They said, 'We marched toward them and entered their city, but they closed its gates against us. We sat down to besiege them. When night fell upon us and we reached its middle, they opened the gate of their city while we were unaware and asleep. None of us were awake except four men: Zayd ibn Harithah, who was in a corner of our camp praying and reciting the Quran; Abdullah ibn Rawahah, who was in another corner praying and reciting the Quran; Qatadah ibn al-Nu'man, who was in another corner praying and reciting the Quran; and Qays ibn Asim, who was in another corner praying and reciting the Quran. They came out in the pitch-black night and pelted us with their arrows. It was their city, and they were knowledgeable of its paths and positions, while we were ignorant of them. We said among ourselves, 'We have been struck and overtaken! This is a dark night, and it is impossible for us to protect ourselves from the arrows because we cannot see them.' While we were in that state, we saw a light coming out from the mouth of Qays ibn Asim al-Minqari like a blazing fire, a light coming out from the mouth of Qatadah ibn al-Nu'man like the light of Venus and Jupiter, a light coming out from the mouth of Abdullah ibn Rawahah like the radiance of the moon on a dark night, and a shining light from the mouth of Zayd ibn Harithah brighter than the rising sun...' He (the Prophet) said: 'As for Zayd ibn Harithah, from whose mouth a light brighter than the rising sun emerged, he is the master of the people and the best of them. Allah knew what would come of him, so He chose him and favored him based on His knowledge of what would come of him. On the day that coincided with this night in which the believers triumphed, a man from the hypocrites of their army came to him, wanting to sow discord between him and Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) and corrupt the relationship between them. He said to him, 'Bravo! Bravo to you! You have no equal among the family of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and his companions. This is your trial, and this is the light of yours that we witnessed.' Zayd said to him, 'O servant of Allah, fear Allah and do not exaggerate in your speech, and do not raise me above my station, for you are thereby opposing Allah and disbelieving in Him. If I were to accept this statement of yours, I would be like that. O servant of Allah, shall I not tell you what happened in the early days of Islam and thereafter, until the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) entered Medina and married Fatimah (peace be upon her) to Ali, and Hasan and Husayn (peace be upon them) were born?' He said, 'Yes.' He said, 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had great love for me, to the point that he adopted me, and I was called Zayd ibn Muhammad until Hasan and Husayn (peace be upon them), the children of Ali (peace be upon him), were born. I disliked that for their sake and said to those who called me [by that name], 'I would like you to call me Zayd, the freedman (mawla) of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), for I dislike to be compared to Hasan and Husayn (peace be upon them).' This continued until Allah confirmed my belief and revealed to Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family): 'Allah has not made for any man two hearts in his interior' (33:4), meaning a heart that loves Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) and his family and honors them, and a heart with which he honors others as he honors them, or a heart with which he loves their enemies. Rather, whoever loves their enemies hates them and does not love them, and whoever treats their followers as equal to them hates them and does not love them. Then He said: 'Nor has He made your wives whom you declare to be like your mothers your mothers, nor has He made your adopted sons your sons... and those of blood relationship are more entitled to each other in the Book of Allah' (33:4-6), meaning Hasan and Husayn (peace be upon them) are more entitled to the sonship of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) in the Book of Allah and His ordinance than the believers and the Muhajirun, unless you do a favor to your allies, an act of kindness and honor, but that does not reach the status of children. This was written in the Book. So they left that and began saying, 'Zayd is the brother of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).' He said, 'People continued to say this to me, and I disliked it, until the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) reaffirmed the brotherhood between himself and Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him).' Then Zayd said, 'O servant of Allah, Zayd is the freedman (mawla) of Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) just as he is the freedman of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). So do not make him his equal, and do not raise him above his station, lest you be like the Christians when they raised Isa (Jesus) (peace be upon him) above his station and disbelieved in the Great Allah.' The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said, 'It is for this reason that Allah favored Zayd with what you saw and honored him with what you witnessed. By the One who sent me with the truth as a Prophet, what Allah has prepared for Zayd in the Hereafter makes what you witnessed of his light in this world seem small. He will come on the Day of Resurrection with his light traveling in front of him, behind him, to his right, to his left, above him, and below him, from every side, for a distance of a thousand years.'"
4.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 18

5.ar: الکاظم (- مَنْ کَانَتْ أُمُّهُ مِنْ بَنِی هَاشِمٍ وَ أَبُوهُ مِنْ سَائِرِ قُرَیْشٍ فَإِنَّ الصَّدَقَاتِ تَحِلُّ لَهُ وَ لَیْسَ لَهُ مِنَ الْخُمُسِ شَیْءٌ لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَی یَقُولُ ادْعُوهُمْ لِآبائِهِمْ.
5.fa: امام کاظم (- هرکس مادرش از بنی‌هاشم باشد و پدرش از دیگر خانوادههای قریش باشد، صدقه به آنان جایز است و بهره‌ای از خمس ندارند؛ چرا که خدای عزّوجلّ می‌فرماید: ادْعُوهُمْ لِآبَائِهِمْ.
5.en: Whoever has a mother from Banu Hashim and a father from the other families of Quraysh, then charity (sadaqah) is permissible for him, and he has no share in the khums, because God Almighty says: "Call them by [the names of] their fathers."
5.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 1, p. 539; Tahdhib al-Ahkam, Vol. 4, p. 128; Wasa'il al-Shi'ah, Vol. 9, p. 271; 'Awali al-La'ali, Vol. 3, p. 129

5.ar: الرّضا (- عَن مُحَمَّدِ بنِ سَنَان أَنَّ أَبَاالْحَسَنِ عَلِیَّ بْنَ مُوسَی الرِّضَا (کَتَبَ إِلَیْهِ فِی جَوَابِ مَسَائِلِهِ ... عِلَّةُ تَحْلِیلِ مَالِ الْوَلَدِ لِوَالِدِهِ بِغَیْرِ إِذْنِهِ وَ لَیْسَ ذَلِکَ لِلْوَلَدِ لِأَنَّ الْوَلَدَ مَوْهُوبٌ لِلْوَالِدِ فِی قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ یَهَبُ لِمَنْ یَشاءُ إِناثاً وَ یَهَبُ لِمَنْ یَشاءُ الذُّکُورَ مَعَ أَنَّهُ الْمَأْخُوذُ بِمَئُونَتِهِ صَغِیراً وَ کَبِیراً وَ الْمَنْسُوبُ إِلَیْهِ وَ الْمَدْعُوُّ لَهُ لِقَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ ادْعُوهُمْ لِآبائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَ قَوْلِ النَّبِیِّ (أَنْتَ وَ مَالُکَ لِأَبِیکَ وَ لَیْسَتِ الْوَالِدَةُ کَذَلِکَ.
5.en: Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated that Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (AS) wrote to him in response to his questions: "...The reason for the permissibility of a child's wealth for their father without the child's permission—while the father's wealth is not permissible for the child without the father's permission—is that the child is a gift to the father, according to the words of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: 'He bestows upon whom He wills female [children], and He bestows upon whom He wills males' (Ash-Shura: 49). Furthermore, the father is responsible for the child's expenses, both when the child is young and when they are grown, and the child is attributed to him and called by his name, due to the words of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: 'Call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allah' (Al-Ahzab: 5), and the words of the Prophet (PBUH): 'You and your wealth belong to your father.' The mother is not like this."
5.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 100; Uyun Akhbar al-Rida (Vol. 2, p. 96, where the phrase 'and the words of the Prophet: You...' to the end is omitted); Nur al-Thaqalayn.

6.ar: الصّادق (- عَن عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَی قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَبَاعَبْدِاللَّهِ (عَنْ قَوْلِ الْعَامَّةِ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (قَالَ مَنْ مَاتَ وَ لَیْسَ لَهُ إِمَامٌ مَاتَ مِیتَةً جَاهِلِیَّةً فَقَالَ الْحَقُّ وَ اللَّهِ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّ إِمَاماً هَلَکَ وَ رَجُلٌ بِخُرَاسَانَ لَا یَعْلَمُ مَنْ وَصِیُّهُ لَمْ یَسَعْهُ ذَلِکَ قَالَ لَا یَسَعُهُ إِنَّ الْإِمَامَ إِذَا هَلَکَ وَقَعَتْ حُجَّةُ وَصِیِّهِ عَلَی مَنْ هُوَ مَعَهُ فِی الْبَلَدِ وَ حَقُّ النَّفْرِ عَلَی مَنْ لَیْسَ بِحَضْرَتِهِ إِذَا بَلَغَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ یَقُولُ فَلَوْ لا نَفَرَ مِنْ کُلِّ فِرْقَةٍ مِنْهُمْ طائِفَةٌ لِیَتَفَقَّهُوا فِی الدِّینِ وَ لِیُنْذِرُوا قَوْمَهُمْ إِذا رَجَعُوا إِلَیْهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَحْذَرُونَ قُلْتُ فَنَفَرَ قَوْمٌ فَهَلَکَ بَعْضُهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ یَصِلَ فَیَعْلَمَ قَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ یَقُولُ وَ مَنْ یَخْرُجْ مِنْ بَیْتِهِ مُهاجِراً إِلَی اللهِ وَ رَسُولِهِ ثُمَّ یُدْرِکْهُ الْمَوْتُ فَقَدْ وَقَعَ أَجْرُهُ عَلَی اللهِ قُلْتُ فَبَلَغَ الْبَلَدَ بَعْضُهُمْ فَوَجَدَکَ مُغْلَقاً عَلَیْکَ بَابُکَ وَ مُرْخًی عَلَیْکَ سِتْرُکَ لَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَی نَفْسِکَ وَ لَا یَکُونُ مَنْ یَدُلُّهُمْ عَلَیْکَ فَبِمَا یَعْرِفُونَ ذَلِکَ قَالَ بِکِتَابِ اللَّهِ الْمُنْزَلِ قُلْتُ فَیَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ کَیْفَ قَالَ أَرَاکَ قَدْ تَکَلَّمْتَ فِی هَذَا قَبْلَ الْیَوْمِ قُلْتُ أَجَلْ قَالَ فَذَکِّرْ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِی عَلِیٍّ (وَ مَا قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (فِی حَسَنٍ وَ حُسَیْنٍ (وَ مَا خَصَّ اللَّهُ بِهِ عَلِیّاً (وَ مَا قَالَ فِیهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (مِنْ وَصِیَّتِهِ إِلَیْهِ وَ نَصْبِهِ إِیَّاهُ وَ مَا یُصِیبُهُمْ وَ إِقْرَارِ الْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَیْنِ (بِذَلِکَ وَ وَصِیَّتِهِ إِلَی الْحَسَنِ (وَ تَسْلِیمِ الْحُسَیْنِ (لَهُ بِقَوْلِ اللَّهِ النَّبِیُّ أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ أَزْواجُهُ أُمَّهاتُهُمْ وَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلی بِبَعْضٍ فِی کِتابِ الله.
6.en: Abd al-A’la said: I asked Abu Abd Allah (al-Sadiq) about the statement of the general public that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: "Whoever dies without having an Imam, dies the death of the Age of Ignorance (Jahiliyyah)." He replied: "By Allah, this is the truth." I asked: "If an Imam dies and a man is in Khurasan, not knowing who his successor (wasi) is, is he excused?" He said: "He is not excused. When an Imam dies, the proof of his successor falls upon those who are with him in the city, and the obligation to travel falls upon those who are not in his presence once the news reaches them. For Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, says: 'Why should not a party from every group of them go forth to gain sound knowledge in religion and to warn their people when they return to them, that they may beware?' (9:122). I asked: "If a group travels, but some of them die before they arrive and gain knowledge?" He said: "Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, says: 'And whoever leaves his home, migrating to Allah and His Messenger, and then death overtakes him, his reward has already fallen upon Allah.' (4:100). I asked: "If some of them reach the city and find you with your door closed and your curtain drawn, and you do not call them to yourself, nor is there anyone to guide them to you, how then shall they recognize him?" He said: "By the revealed Book of Allah." I asked: "How does Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, say this?" He said: "I see you have spoken of this before today." I said: "Yes." He said: "Then recall what Allah revealed regarding Ali (AS), and what the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said to him regarding Hasan and Husayn (AS), and what Allah specifically granted to Ali (AS), and what the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said regarding his (Ali's) successorship and his appointment of him, and what would befall them, and the acknowledgment of Hasan and Husayn (AS) of that, and his (Ali's) testament to Hasan (AS), and the submission of Husayn (AS) to him, in accordance with the word of Allah: 'The Prophet is closer to the believers than their own selves, and his wives are their mothers. And those of blood relationship are closer to each other in the Book of Allah.'" (33:6).
6.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 1, p. 378; Nur al-Thaqalayn (which notes "rafa'at" instead of "waqa'at").

6.ar: العسکری (- وَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلی بِبَعْضٍ فِی کِتابِ اللهِ یَعْنِی الْحَسَنُ وَ الْحُسَیْنُ (أَوْلَی بِبُنُوَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فِی کِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَ فَرْضِهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ الْمُهاجِرِینَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَفْعَلُوا إِلی أَوْلِیائِکُمْ مَعْرُوفاً إِحْسَاناً وَ إِکْرَاماً لَا یَبْلُغُ ذَلِکَ مَحَلَ الْأَوْلَادِ کانَ ذلِکَ فِی الْکِتابِ مَسْطُورا.
6.fa: امام عسکری (- مراد از وَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلی بِبَعْضٍ فِی کِتابِ اللهِ حسین و حسین (هستند که در کتاب خدا سزاوارتر به فرزندی رسول خدا (می‌باشند و مِنَ الْمؤْمِنِینَ وَ الْمهاجِرِینَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَفْعَلُوا إِلی أَوْلِیائِکُمْ مَعْرُوفاً به‌خاطر اینکه با اولیاء خود به نیکی و احسان و اکرام برخورد نمایند تا حدّی که جایگاه فرزندانشان به این رتبه نمی‌رسد و کانَ ذلِکَ فِی الْکِتابِ مَسْطُورا این حقیقت در قرآن مذکور است.
6.en: "And those of kinship are closer to one another in the Book of Allah" means al-Hasan and al-Husayn, who are more entitled to the sonship of the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) in the Book of Allah and His ordinance than the believers and the emigrants. "Except that you do to your allies a kindness," meaning through goodness, benevolence, and honoring them, though this does not reach the status of children. "That is inscribed in the Book."
6.refs: Al-Imam al-Askari, p. 642 / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 22, p. 82 / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 94, p. 60

6.ar: الباقر (- عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْن زَیْدٍ مَوْلَی أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (قَالَ سَأَلْتُ مَوْلَایَ فَقُلْتُ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّوَجَلَ وَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلی بِبَعْضٍ فِی کِتابِ اللهِ قَالَ هُوَ عَلِی (.
6.fa: امام باقر (- محمّدبن‌زید غلام امام باقر (گوید: «از مولایم درباره‌ی آیه‌ی وَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلی بِبَعْضٍ پرسیدم فرمود: «منظور علی (است».
6.en: Muhammad ibn Zayd, the freed slave of Abu Ja'far (al-Baqir), said: "I asked my master about the saying of the Almighty and Majestic, '...and those of kinship are closer to one another in the Book of Allah' (33:6). He said: 'It is Ali (AS).'"

6.ar: الرّسول (- عَنْ سُلَیْمِ بْنِ قَیْسٍ الْهِلَالِیِّ قَال سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَاللَّهِ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ الطَّیَّارِ یَقُولُ کُنَّا عِنْدَ مُعَاوِیَةَ وَ الْحَسَنُ وَ الْحُسَیْنُ (وَ عَبْدُاللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَ عُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِی سَلَمَةَ وَ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَیْدٍ یَذْکُرُ حَدِیثاً جَرَی بَیْنَهُ وَ بَیْنَهُ وَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِمُعَاوِیَةَ بْنِ أَبِی سُفْیَانَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (یَقُولُ إِنِّی أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ ثُمَّ أَخِی عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَإِذَا اسْتُشْهِدَ فَابْنِیَ الْحَسَنُ (أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ ثُمَّ ابْنِیَ الْحُسَیْنُ أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَإِذَا اسْتُشْهِدَ فَابْنُهُ عَلِیٌّ (أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ سَتُدْرِکُهُ یَا عَلِیُّ (ثُمَّ ابْنِی مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِیٍّ الْبَاقِرُ (أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ سَتُدْرِکُهُ یَا حُسَیْنُ وَ تُکْمِلُهُ اثْنَا عَشَرَ إِمَاماً تِسْعَةٌ مِنْ وُلْدِ الْحُسَیْنِ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَشْهَدْتُ الْحَسَنَ وَ الْحُسَیْنَ (وَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ وَ عُمَرَ بْنَ أَبِی سَلَمَةَ وَ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَیْدٍ فَشَهِدُوا لِی عِنْدَ مُعَاوِیَةَ قَالَ سُلَیْمُ بْنُ قَیْسٍ وَ قَدْ کُنْتُ سَمِعْتُ ذَلِکَ مِنْ سَلْمَانَ (وَ أَبِی ذَرٍّ (وَ الْمِقْدَادِ وَ أُسَامَةَ أَنَّهُمْ سَمِعُوا ذَلِکَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (.
6.fa: پیامبر (- سلیم‌بن‌قیس هلالی گوید: از عبداللَّه‌بن‌جعفرطیّار شنیدم که می‌گفت: «من و حسن و حسین (و عبداللَّه‌بن‌عبّاس (و عمربن‌ابی‌سلمهًْ و اسامهًْ‌بن‌زید نزد معاویه بودیم و حدیثی را که ما بین آن‌ها بحث شده بود، یاد می‌کرد و اینکه به معاویهًْ‌بن‌ابی‌سفیان گفته است که از رسول خدا (شنیدم که می‌فرمود: «من از مؤمنان بر خودشان اولی هستم، سپس برادرم علی (اولای به مؤمنان از خودشان است و آنگاه که شهید شود حسن (اولای به مؤمنان از خودشان است، سپس فرزندم حسین (اولای به مؤمنان از خودشان است و چون شهید شود، فرزندش علیّ اولای به مؤمنان از خودشان خواهد بود و تو ای علی (! او را خواهی دید، سپس فرزندش محمّدبن‌علی (اولای به مؤمنان از خودشان خواهد بود و تو ای حسین (او را خواهی دید، سپس دوازده امام را کامل کرد و نه تن آن‌ها از فرزندان حسین (هستند». عبداللَّه‌بن‌جعفر گوید: «سپس از حسن و حسین (و عبداللَّه‌بن‌عبّاس و عمربن‌أبی‌سلمهًْ و اسامهًْ‌بن‌زید گواهی خواستم و آنان نزد معاویه برایم شهادت دادند»، من از سلمان (و ابوذر (و مقداد (و اسامهًْ‌بن‌زید (نیز این حدیث را شنیدم و آن‌ها هم گفتند که آن را از رسول خدا (شنیده‌اند.
6.en: Sulaym ibn Qays al-Hilali said: I heard Abdullah ibn Ja’far al-Tayyar saying: "We were in the presence of Mu’awiyah, along with al-Hasan, al-Husayn, Abdullah ibn Abbas, Umar ibn Abi Salamah, and Usamah ibn Zayd. He (Abdullah ibn Ja’far) was recounting a conversation that had taken place between him and Mu’awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan, and that he had said to him: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) saying: "I am more entitled to the believers than their own selves. Then, my brother Ali ibn Abi Talib is more entitled to the believers than their own selves. When he is martyred, then my son al-Hasan is more entitled to the believers than their own selves. Then my son al-Husayn is more entitled to the believers than their own selves. When he is martyred, then his son Ali is more entitled to the believers than their own selves—and you shall meet him, O Ali. Then my son Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir is more entitled to the believers than their own selves—and you shall meet him, O Husayn." He then completed the number of twelve Imams, nine of whom are from the descendants of al-Husayn.' Abdullah said: 'Then I asked al-Hasan, al-Husayn, Abdullah ibn Abbas, Umar ibn Abi Salamah, and Usamah ibn Zayd to bear witness, and they testified for me before Mu’awiyah.'" Sulaym ibn Qays said: "I had also heard this from Salman, Abu Dharr, al-Miqdad, and Usamah, and they said that they had heard it from the Messenger of Allah (PBUH)."
6.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 26
6.refs: Nur al-Thaqalayn / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 36, p. 231

6.ar: الرّسول (- عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ (قَالَ کُنْتُ مَعَ مُعَاوِیَةَ وَ قَدْ نَزَلَ بِذِی طُوًی فَجَاءَهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِی وَقَّاصٍ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَیْهِ فَقَالَ مُعَاوِیَةُ یَا أَهْلَ الشَّامِ هَذَا سَعْدٌ وَ هُوَ صَدِیقٌ لِعَلِیٍّ (قَالَ فَطَأْطَأَ الْقَوْمُ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَ سَبُّوا عَلِیّاً فَبَکَی سَعْدٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ مُعَاوِیَةُ مَا الَّذِی أَبْکَاکَ قَالَ وَ لِمَ لَا أَبْکِی لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (یُسَبُّ عِنْدَکَ وَ لَا أَسْتَطِیعُ أَنْ أُغَیِّرَ وَ قَدْ کَانَ فِی عَلِیٍّ خِصَالٌ لَأَنْ تَکُونَ فِیَّ وَاحِدَةٌ مِنْهُنَّ أَحَبُّ إِلَیَّ مِنَ الدُّنْیَا وَ مَا فِیهَا أَحَدُهَا أَنَّ رَجُلًا کَانَ بِالْیَمَنِ فَجَاءَ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (فَقَالَ لَأَشْکُوَنَّکَ إِلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فَقَدِمَ عَلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ عَلِیٍّ فَشَنَأَ عَلَیْهِ فَقَالَ (أَنْشُدُکَ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِی أَنْزَلَ عَلَیَّ الْکِتَابَ وَ اخْتَصَّنِی بِالرِّسَالَةِ أَ عَنْ سَخَطٍ تَقُولُ مَا تَقُولُ فِی عَلِیٍّ (قَالَ نَعَمْ یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (قَالَ أَ لَا تَعْلَمُ أَنِّی أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ قَالَ بَلَی قَالَ فَمَنْ کُنْتُ مَوْلَاهُ فَعَلِیٌّ (مَوْلَاه.
6.fa: پیامبر (- از ابن‌عبّاس (روایت است که گفت: نزد معاویه که در ذی‌طوی مسکن گزیده بود، رفته بودم که سعدبن‌ابی و قّاص پیش معاویه آمد و بر او سلام کرد. معاویه گفت: «ای مردم شام! این، سعدبن‌ابی وقّاص و دوست علی (است». مردم، سر را به زیر انداخته و به علی (دشنام دادند. پس سعد گریست و معاویه به او گفت: «چرا گریه می‌کنی»؟ سعد پاسخ داد: «چرا گریه نکنم درحالی‌که نزد تو به مردی از اصحاب رسول خدا (دشنام داده می‌شود و من نمی‌توانم کاری بکنم؟! درحالی‌که علی (دارای صفاتی است که اگر یکی از آن‌ها در من بود، آن را بیشتر از دنیا و آنچه که در آن است، دوست می‌داشتم. یکی از آن صفات این است که مردی در یمن بود و آن مرد به علی (گفت: «نزد رسول خدا (از تو شکایت می‌کنم». آن مرد نزد رسول خدا (آمده و درباره‌ی علی (از او پرسید. رسول خدا (علی (را مدح نموده و فرمود: «تو را به خدایی که این کتاب را بر من نازل فرمود و رسالت را به من اختصاص داد، سوگند می‌دهم، آیا از روی خشم این مطالب را پیرامون علیّ‌بن‌ابی‌طالب (می‌گویی»؟ آن مرد پاسخ داد: «آری، ای رسول خدا (»! رسول خدا (فرمود: «آیا نمی‌دانی که من شایسته‌تر از مؤمنان به خودشان هستم»؟ آن مرد پاسخ داد: «آری می‌دانم». رسول خدا (فرمود: «پس هرکه من مولای اویم، علی (مولای اوست»».
6.en: I was with Mu'awiyah when he had descended at Dhu Tuwa. Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas came to him and greeted him. Mu'awiyah said, "O people of Syria, this is Sa'd, and he is a friend of Ali." The people lowered their heads and cursed Ali. Sa'd wept, and Mu'awiyah asked him, "What makes you weep?" He replied, "Why should I not weep when a man from the companions of the Messenger of Allah is being cursed in your presence and I am unable to change it? Ali possessed qualities such that if I had even one of them, it would be dearer to me than the world and all that is in it. One of them is that there was a man in Yemen, and Ali ibn Abi Talib came to him. The man said, 'I will complain about you to the Messenger of Allah.' He came to the Messenger of Allah and asked him about Ali, and he spoke ill of him. The Prophet said, 'I adjure you by Allah, who revealed the Book to me and chose me for the Message, do you say what you say about Ali out of anger?' The man replied, 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.' The Prophet said, 'Do you not know that I am closer to the believers than their own selves?' He replied, 'Yes.' The Prophet said, 'Then whoever I am his Mawla (master/leader), Ali is his Mawla.'"
6.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 26

6.ar: الرّسول (- أَنَّ أَمِیرَالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (قَالَ أَمَرَنِی رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (أَنْ أَخْرُجَ فَأُنَادِیَ فِی النَّاسِ أَلَا مَنْ ظَلَمَ أَجِیراً أَجْرَهُ فَعَلَیْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ أَلَا مَنْ تَوَالَی غَیْرَ مَوَالِیهِ فَعَلَیْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ أَلَا وَ مَنْ سَبَّ أَبَوَیْهِ فَعَلَیْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ قَالَ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (فَخَرَجْتُ فَنَادَیْتُ فِی النَّاسِ کَمَا أَمَرَنِی النَّبِیُّ (فَقَالَ لِی عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ هَلْ لِمَا نَادَیْتَ بِهِ مِنْ تَفْسِیرٍ فَقُلْتُ اللَّهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ (أَعْلَمُ قَالَ فَقَامَ عُمَرُ وَ جَمَاعَةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِیِّ (فَدَخَلُوا عَلَیْهِ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (هَلْ لِمَا نَادَی عَلِیٌّ (مِنْ تَفْسِیرٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ أَمَرْتُهُ أَنْ یُنَادِیَ أَلَا مَنْ ظَلَمَ أَجِیراً أَجْرَهُ فَعَلَیْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَ اللَّهُ (یَقُولُ قُلْ لا أَسْئَلُکُمْ عَلَیْهِ أَجْراً إِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِی الْقُرْبی فَمَنْ ظَلَمَنَا فَعَلَیْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَ أَمَرْتُهُ أَنْ یُنَادِیَ مَنْ تَوَالَی غَیْرَ مَوَالِیهِ فَعَلَیْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَ اللَّهُ یَقُولُ النَّبِیُّ أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ مَنْ کُنْتُ مَوْلَاهُ فَعَلِیٌّ (مَوْلَاهُ فَمَنْ تَوَالَی غَیْرَ عَلِیٍّ (فَعَلَیْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَ أَمَرْتُهُ أَنْ یُنَادِیَ مَنْ سَبَّ أَبَوَیْهِ فَعَلَیْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّه.
6.en: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: "The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) commanded me to go out and proclaim to the people: 'Beware, whoever cheats a hired worker out of his wages, upon him is the curse of Allah. Beware, whoever takes masters other than his own, upon him is the curse of Allah. Beware, whoever curses his parents, upon him is the curse of Allah.' I went out and proclaimed to the people just as the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) had commanded me. Then Umar ibn al-Khattab said to me, 'Is there an interpretation for what you have proclaimed?' I replied, 'Allah and His Messenger know best.' Umar and a group of the Prophet’s companions went to him and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, is there an interpretation for what Ali proclaimed?' He replied, 'Yes. I commanded him to proclaim: "Beware, whoever cheats a hired worker out of his wages, upon him is the curse of Allah," for Allah the Almighty says: *Say: I ask of you no reward for it except love for my near kin* (Shura/23). So whoever wrongs us, upon him is the curse of Allah. And I commanded him to proclaim: "Whoever takes masters other than his own, upon him is the curse of Allah," for Allah says: *The Prophet is closer to the believers than their own selves*, and "Whoever I am his master (mawla), Ali is his master." So whoever takes a master other than Ali, upon him is the curse of Allah. And I commanded him to proclaim: "Whoever curses his parents, upon him is the curse of Allah."'"
6.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 26
6.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 22, p. 489; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 44, p. 97

6.ar: أمیرالمؤمنین (- قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ إِنَّ أَوْلَی النَّاسِ بِإِبْراهِیمَ لَلَّذِینَ اتَّبَعُوهُ وَ هذَا النَّبِیُّ وَ قَالَ وَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلی بِبَعْضٍ فِی کِتابِ اللهِ فَنَحْنُ أَوْلَی النَّاسِ بِإِبْرَاهِیمَ وَ نَحْنُ وَرِثْنَاهُ وَ نَحْنُ أُولُو الْأَرْحَامِ الَّذِینَ وَرِثْنَا الْکَعْبَةَ وَ نَحْنُ آلُ إِبْرَاهِیم.
6.fa: امام علی (- خداوند در این آیه فرماید: إِنَّ أَوْلَی النَّاسِ بِإِبْراهِیمَ لَلَّذِینَ اتَّبَعُوهُ وَ هذَا النَّبِیُ و نیز فرموده است: وَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلی بِبَعْضٍ فِی کِتابِ اللهِ. پس ماییم شایسته‌ترین مردم نسبت به حضرت ابراهیم (و ماییم وارث و رحم و خانواده‌ی او که وارث کعبه شدیم، و ماییم آل ابراهیم (.
6.en: Allah the Almighty said: "Indeed, the people most worthy of Abraham are those who followed him, and this Prophet." And He also said: "And those of kinship are closer to one another in the Book of Allah." Thus, we are the people most worthy of Abraham, and we are his inheritors, and we are the people of kinship who inherited the Kaaba, and we are the family of Abraham.
6.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 28

6.ar: أمیرالمؤمنین (- رُوِیَ أَنَّ عَلِیّاً (کَتَبَ إِلَی مُعَاوِیَةَ: مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلِیِّ بْنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (إِلَی مُعَاوِیَةَ ... فَنَحْنُ آلُ نَبِیِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ (أَ لَمْ تَعْلَمْ یَا مُعَاوِیَةُ إِنَّ أَوْلَی النَّاسِ بِإِبْراهِیمَ لَلَّذِینَ اتَّبَعُوهُ وَ هذَا النَّبِیُّ وَ الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا وَ نَحْنُ أُولُو الْأَرْحَامِ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی النَّبِیُّ أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ أَزْواجُهُ أُمَّهاتُهُمْ وَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلی بِبَعْضٍ فِی کِتابِ اللهِ نَحْنُ أَهْلُ بَیْتٍ ... فَکَتَبَ مُعَاوِیَةُ: مِنْ مُعَاوِیَةَ بْنِ أَبِی سُفْیَانَ إِلَی عَلِیِّ بْنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (قَدِ انْتَهَی إِلَیَّ کِتَابُکَ فَأَکْثَرْتَ فِیهِ ذِکْرَ إِبْرَاهِیمَ وَ إِسْمَاعِیلَ وَ آدَمَ وَ نُوحٍ وَ النَّبِیِّینَ (وَ ذِکْرَ مُحَمَّدٍ (وَ قَرَابَتَکُمْ مِنْهُ وَ مَنْزِلَتَکُمْ وَ حَقَّکَ وَ لَمْ تَرْضَ بِقَرَابَتِکَ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ (حَتَّی انْتَسَبْتَ إِلَی جَمِیعِ النَّبِیِّین (... فَأَجَابَهُ (وَ أَمَّا الَّذِی أَنْکَرْتَ مِنْ نَسَبِی مِنْ إِبْرَاهِیمَ (وَ إِسْمَاعِیلَ (وَ قَرَابَتِی مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ (وَ فَضْلِی وَ حَقِّی وَ مُلْکِی وَ إِمَامَتِی فَإِنَّکَ لَمْ تَزَلْ مُنْکِراً لِذَلِکَ لَمْ یُؤْمِنْ بِهِ قَلْبُکَ أَلَا وَ إِنَّا أَهْلَ الْبَیْتَ کَذَلِکَ لَا یُحِبُّنَا کَافِرٌ وَ لَا یُبْغِضُنَا مُؤْمِنٌ وَ الَّذِی أَنْکَرْتَ مِنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ فَقَدْ آتَیْنا آلَ إِبْراهِیمَ الْکِتابَ وَ الْحِکْمَةَ وَ آتَیْناهُمْ مُلْکاً عَظِیماً فَأَنْکَرْتَ أَنْ تَکُونَ فِینَا فَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ النَّبِیُّ أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ أَزْواجُهُ أُمَّهاتُهُمْ وَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلی بِبَعْضٍ فِی کِتابِ اللهِ وَ نَحْنُ أَوْلَی بِه.
6.en:
It is narrated that Ali (as) wrote to Mu'awiyah: "From the servant of Allah, Ali ibn Abi Talib, the Commander of the Faithful, to Mu'awiyah... We are the family of our Prophet Muhammad (saw). O Mu'awiyah, do you not know that Allah the Almighty says: 'Indeed, the most worthy of Abraham among the people are those who followed him [in his time], and this Prophet, and those who believe [in his message]' (3:68)? And we are the 'Ulu al-Arham' (those of kinship) mentioned in the verse: 'The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are their mothers, and those of kinship are closer to one another in the Book of Allah' (33:6). We are the Ahl al-Bayt..."

Mu'awiyah wrote back: "From Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan to Ali ibn Abi Talib. Your letter has reached me, and you have mentioned therein Abraham, Ishmael, Adam, Noah, and the Prophets (as), and you mentioned Muhammad (saw) and your kinship to him, your status, and your rights. You were not satisfied with your kinship to Muhammad (saw), so you attributed yourself to all the Prophets..."

Ali (as) replied: "As for your denial of my lineage to Abraham and Ishmael (as), and your denial of my kinship to Muhammad (saw), and my virtue, my right, my sovereignty, and my Imamate—you have always been a denier of this, and your heart has never believed in it. Know that we are the Ahl al-Bayt; no disbeliever loves us, and no believer hates us. Regarding what you denied from the words of Allah, the Almighty: 'Or do they envy people for what Allah has given them of His bounty? But We had already given the family of Abraham the Scripture and wisdom and conferred upon them a great kingdom' (4:54)—you denied that this applies to us. Yet Allah has said: 'The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are their mothers, and those of kinship are closer to one another in the Book of Allah,' and we are the most worthy of this priority."
6.refs: Al-Gharat, Vol. 1, p. 119; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 33, p. 136

6.via: Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (as) narrates from his father Ja'far (as), from his father al-Baqir (as), from his father Ali (as), from his father al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (as)
6.ar: الرّسول (- الْإِمَامِ مُوسَی بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ (قَالَ حَدَّثَنِی أَبِی جَعْفَرٌ (عَنْ أَبِیهِ الْبَاقِرِ (قَالَ حَدَّثَنِی أَبِی عَلِیٌّ (قَالَ حَدَّثَنِی أَبِی الْحُسَیْنُ بْنُ عَلِیِّ بْنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (قَال بَیْنَمَا أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (جُلُوسٌ فِی مَسْجِدِهِ بَعْدَ وَفَاتِهِ (یَتَذَاکَرُونَ فَضْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (إِذْ دَخَلَ عَلَیْنَا حِبْرٌ مِنْ أَحْبَارِ یَهُودِ أَهْلِ الشَّامِ قَدْ قَرَأَ التَّوْرَاةَ وَ الْإِنْجِیلَ وَ الزَّبُورَ وَ صُحُفَ إِبْرَاهِیمَ (وَ الْأَنْبِیَاءِ (وَ عَرَفَ دَلَائِلَهُمْ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَیْنَا وَ جَلَسَ ثُمَّ لَبِثَ هُنَیْئَةً (هُنَیْهَةً) ثُمَّ قَالَ یَا أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ (مَا تَرَکْتُمْ لِنَبِیٍّ دَرَجَةً وَ لَا لِمُرْسَلٍ فَضِیلَةً إِلَّا وَ قَدْ تَحَمَّلْتُمُوهَا لِنَبِیِّکُمْ (فَهَلْ عِنْدَکُمْ جَوَابٌ إِنْ أَنَا سَأَلْتُکُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَمِیرُالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (سَلْ یَا أَخَا الْیَهُودِ مَا أَحْبَبْتَ فَإِنِّی أُجِیبُکَ عَنْ کُلِّ مَا تَسْأَلُ بِعَوْنِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی وَ مَنِّهِ فَوَ اللَّهِ مَا أَعْطَی اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ نَبِیّاً وَ لَا مُرْسَلًا دَرَجَةً وَ لَا فَضِیلَةً إِلَّا وَ قَدْ جَمَعَهَا لِمُحَمَّدٍ (وَ زَادَهُ عَلَی الْأَنْبِیَاءِ (وَ الْمُرْسَلِینَ أَضْعَافاً مُضَاعَفَةً ... زَادَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ تَکْرِمَةً بِأَخْذِ مِیثَاقِهِ قَبْلَ النَّبِیِّینَ وَ أَخْذِ مِیثَاقِ النَّبِیِّینَ بِالتَّسْلِیمِ وَ الرِّضَا (وَ التَّصْدِیقِ لَهُ فَقَالَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ وَ إِذْ أَخَذْنا مِنَ النَّبِیِّینَ مِیثاقَهُمْ وَ مِنْکَ وَ مِنْ نُوحٍ وَ إِبْراهِیمَ وَ قَالَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ إِذْ أَخَذَ اللهُ مِیثاقَ النَّبِیِّینَ لَما آتَیْتُکُمْ مِنْ کِتابٍ وَ حِکْمَةٍ ثُمَّ جاءَکُمْ رَسُولٌ مُصَدِّقٌ لِما مَعَکُمْ لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهِ وَ لَتَنْصُرُنَّهُ قالَ أَ أَقْرَرْتُمْ وَ أَخَذْتُمْ عَلی ذلِکُمْ إِصْرِی قالُوا أَقْرَرْنا قالَ فَاشْهَدُوا وَ أَنَا مَعَکُمْ مِنَ الشَّاهِدِینَ وَ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ النَّبِیُّ (أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ.
6.en: He said: While the companions of the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) were sitting in his mosque after his passing, discussing the virtues of the Messenger of Allah (pbuh), a scholar from the Jewish scholars of the Levant entered upon us. He had read the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, the Scrolls of Abraham, and the prophets, and he knew their proofs. He greeted us and sat down. Then he waited for a short while and said: "O nation of Muhammad! You have not left any rank for a prophet nor any virtue for a messenger but that you have attributed it to your prophet. Do you have an answer if I ask you?" The Commander of the Faithful (as) said to him: "Ask, O brother of the Jews, whatever you wish, for I shall answer you regarding everything you ask by the help of Allah the Exalted and His grace. For by Allah, Allah the Mighty and Majestic did not grant any prophet or messenger a rank or virtue but that He gathered it all for Muhammad (pbuh) and increased it for him over the prophets and messengers many times over... Allah the Mighty and Majestic honored him by taking his covenant before the prophets, and by taking the covenant of the prophets to submit, be content, and believe in him. Thus, He, whose praise is exalted, said: 'And [mention, O Muhammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham' (33:7). And the Mighty and Majestic said: 'And [recall, O People of the Scripture], when Allah took the covenant of the prophets, [saying], "Whatever I give you of the Scripture and wisdom and then there comes to you a messenger confirming what is with you, you [must] believe in him and support him." [Allah] said, "Have you acknowledged and taken upon that My commitment?" They said, "We have acknowledged." He said, "Then bear witness, and I am with you among the witnesses."' (3:81). And Allah the Mighty and Majestic said: 'The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves.'" (33:6).

6.ar: الرّسول (- حُذَیْفَةَ بْنِ أَسِیدٍ الْغِفَارِیِّ قَالَ: لَمَّا رَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (مِنْ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ وَ نَحْنُ مَعَهُ أَقْبَلَ حَتَّی انْتَهَی إِلَی الْجُحْفَةِ أَمَرَ أَصْحَابَهُ بِالنُّزُولِ فَنَزَلَ الْقَوْمُ مَنَازِلَهُمْ ثُمَّ نُودِیَ بِالصَّلَاةِ فَصَلَّی بِأَصْحَابِهِ رَکْعَتَیْنِ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ بِوَجْهِهِ إِلَیْهِمْ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ إِنَّهُ قَدْ نَبَّأَنِیَ اللَّطِیفُ الْخَبِیرُ أَنِّی مَیِّتٌ وَ أَنَّکُمْ مَیِّتُونَ وَ کَأَنِّی قَدْ دُعِیتُ فَأَجَبْتُ وَ إِنِّی مَسْئُولٌ عَمَّا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ إِلَیْکُمْ وَ عَمَّا خَلَّفْتُ فِیکُمْ مِنْ کِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَ حُجَّتِهِ وَ إِنَّکُمْ مَسْئُولُونَ فَمَا أَنْتُمْ قَائِلُونَ لِرَبِّکُمْ قَالُوا نَقُولُ قَدْ بَلَّغْتَ وَ نَصَحْتَ وَ جَاهَدْتَ فَجَزَاکَ اللَّهُ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ الْجَزَاءِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَ لَسْتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَ أَنِّی رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (إِلَیْکُمْ وَ أَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ حَقٌّ وَ أَنَّ النَّارَ حَقٌّ وَ أَنَّ الْبَعْثَ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ حَقٌّ فَقَالُوا نَشْهَدُ بِذَلِکَ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ اشْهَدْ عَلَی مَا یَقُولُونَ أَلَا وَ إِنِّی أُشْهِدُکُمْ أَنِّی أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَایَ وَ أَنَا مَوْلَی کُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ وَ أَنَا أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَهَلْ تُقِرُّونَ بِذَلِکَ وَ تَشْهَدُونَ لِی بِهِ فَقَالُوا نَعَمْ نَشْهَدُ لَکَ بِذَلِکَ فَقَالَ أَلَا مَنْ کُنْتُ مَوْلَاهُ فَإِنَّ عَلِیّاً (مَوْلَاهُ وَ هُوَ هَذَا ثُمَّ أَخَذَ بِیَدِ عَلِیٍّ (فَرَفَعَهَا مَعَ یَدِهِ حَتَّی بَدَتْ آبَاطُهُمَا ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ وَالِ مَنْ وَالَاهُ وَ عَادِ مَنْ عَادَاه.
6.fa: پیامبر (- حذیفه‌بن اسید غفاری گوید: چون رسول خدا (درحالی‌که ما نیز همراه وی بودیم، از حجّهًْ‌الوداع بازگشت، به راه خود ادامه داد تا اینکه به حجفه رسید و به یاران خود امر فرمود آنجا اطراق کنند. پس از پیاده‌شدن و مستقرگشتن ندای نماز داده شد و رسول خدا (دو رکعت نماز با صحابه خود اقامه نموده و سپس رو به آن‌ها کرد و فرمود: «خداوند لطیف خبیر مرا خبر داده است که من از دنیا خواهم رفت و شما [نیز] از دنیا خواهم رفت و من نیز اجابت نموده‌ام و من در برابر آنچه به‌خاطر آن به سویتان فرستاده شده‌ام، مسئولم و شما نیز مسئول هستید، پس به پروردگارتان بابت این مسئولیت چه خواهید گفت»؟! گفتند: «خواهیم گفت: شما رسالت خود را ابلاغ فرمودی و نصیحت نمودی و جهاد کردی، پس خداوند بهترین پاداش را از جانب ما به شما مرحمت کند»؛ سپس آن حضرت فرمود: «مگر شهادت نمی‌دهید که خدایی جز الله نیست و من فرستاده‌ی خدا به سوی شما هستم و اینکه بهشت حق است و دوزخ حق و برانگیخته شدن پس از مرگ حق است»؟! گفتند: «به آنچه فرمودید، اقرار داریم». آن حضرت فرمود: «خداوندا! تو خود بر آنچه می‌گویند گواه باش! آگاه باشید که من شما را گواه می‌گیرم براینکه الله مولای من است و من مولای هر مسلمانی، و من از هر مسلمانی به خودش اولی‌تر هستم و من از مؤمنان به خودشان اولی‌ترم، آیا به آنچه گفتم، اقرار دارید و شهادت می‌دهید که نزد شما چنین هستم»؟ گفتند: «آری ما اقرار داریم که نزد ما از چنین منزلتی برخوردارید». پس فرمود: «اینک بدانید هر که من مولای اویم، علی نیز مولای اوست و او همین است». سپس دست علی (را گرفته و با دست خود آنقدر بالا برد که زیربغل هر دو آشکار گردید، سپس فرمود: «خداوندا دوست بدار آن‌که دوستش می‌دارد و دشمن بدار آن‌که با وی دشمنی می‌ورزد».
6.en: Hudhayfah ibn Asid al-Ghifari said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) returned from the Farewell Pilgrimage, and we were with him, he proceeded until he reached al-Juhfah. He commanded his companions to halt, and the people settled in their places. Then the call to prayer was made, and he performed two rak'ahs of prayer with his companions. He then turned his face toward them and said: "The Subtle, the All-Aware has informed me that I am to die and you are to die. It is as if I have been called and have answered. I am responsible for that which I was sent to you with, and for that which I have left among you: the Book of Allah and His proof. You, too, shall be questioned, so what will you say to your Lord?" They replied, "We will say: You have conveyed, advised, and struggled; may Allah grant you the best of rewards on our behalf." He then said to them, "Do you not bear witness that there is no god but Allah, that I am the Messenger of Allah to you, that Paradise is true, that the Fire is true, and that the resurrection after death is true?" They said, "We bear witness to that." He said, "O Allah, be witness to what they say. Know that I call you to witness that Allah is my Mawla (Master), and I am the Mawla of every Muslim, and I am more entitled to the believers than they are to themselves. Do you acknowledge this and bear witness to it for me?" They replied, "Yes, we bear witness to that for you." He then said, "Know that whoever I am his Mawla, Ali is his Mawla, and he is this one." He then took Ali’s hand and raised it with his own until their armpits became visible, then said, "O Allah, befriend whoever befriends him and be hostile to whoever is hostile to him."
6.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 30
6.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 37, p. 121; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 23, p. 141

6.ar: الرّسول (- عَن عَطِیَّةَ السَّعْدِیِّ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ حُذَیْفَةَ بْنَ الْیَمَانِ عَنْ إِقَامَةِ النَّبِیِّ (عَلِیّاً یَوْمَ الْغَدِیرِ غَدِیرِ خُمٍّ کَیْفَ کَانَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَی أَنْزَلَ عَلَی نَبِیِّهِ (أَقُولُ أَنَا لَعَلَّهُ یَعْنِی بِالْمَدِینَةِ النَّبِیُّ (أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ أَزْواجُهُ أُمَّهاتُهُمْ وَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلی بِبَعْضٍ فِی کِتابِ اللهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ الْمُهاجِرِینَ فَقَالُوا یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (مَا هَذِهِ الْوَلَایَةُ الَّتِی أَنْتُمْ بِهَا أَحَقُّ مِنَّا بِأَنْفُسِنَا فَقَالَ (السَّمْعَ وَ الطَّاعَةَ فِیمَا أَحْبَبْتُمْ وَ کَرِهْتُمْ فَقُلْنَا سَمِعْنَا وَ أَطَعْنَا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی وَ اذْکُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللهِ عَلَیْکُمْ وَ مِیثاقَهُ الَّذِی واثَقَکُمْ بِهِ إِذْ قُلْتُمْ سَمِعْنا وَ أَطَعْنا.
6.en: 'Atiyyah al-Sa'di said: I asked Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman about how the Prophet (PBUH) established the leadership of Ali (PBUH) on the day of Ghadir (Ghadir Khumm). He said: "Allah the Exalted revealed to His Prophet (PBUH) [I (the author) say: perhaps he means in Medina]: 'The Prophet is closer to the believers than their own selves, and his wives are their mothers. And the possessors of kinship are closer to one another in the Book of Allah than the [other] believers and the emigrants' (33:6). They said: 'O Messenger of Allah, what is this wilayah (authority) by which you are more entitled to us than we are to our own selves?' He replied: 'Listening and obeying in what you love and what you dislike.' We said: 'We have heard and we have obeyed.' Then Allah the Exalted revealed: 'And remember the favor of Allah upon you and His covenant with which He bound you when you said, "We hear and we obey"'" (5:7).
6.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 32
6.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 37, p. 127; Iqbal al-A'mal, p. 454, in which it says: "Then Allah the Exalted revealed: 'And remember...'" to the end, with the rest omitted.

6.ar: أمیرالمؤمنین (- قَالَ رِیَاحُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ کُنْتُ فِی الرَّحْبَةِ مَعَ أَمِیرِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (إِذْ أَقْبَلَ رَکْبٌ یَسِیرُونَ حَتَّی أَنَاخُوا بِالرَّحْبَةِ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلُوا یَمْشُونَ حَتَّی أَتَوْا عَلِیّاً (فَقَالُوا السَّلَامُ عَلَیْکَ یَا أَمِیرَالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (وَ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَ بَرَکَاتُهُ قَالَ مَنِ الْقَوْمُ قَالُوا مَوَالِیکَ یَا أَمِیرَالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (قَالَ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَیْهِ وَ هُوَ یَضْحَکُ وَ یَقُولُ مِنْ أَیْنَ وَ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَرَبٌ قَالُوا سَمِعْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (یَقُولُ یَوْمَ غَدِیرِ خُمٍّ وَ هُوَ آخِذٌ بِیَدِکَ یَقُولُ أَیُّهَا النَّاسُ أَ لَسْتُ أَوْلی بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ قُلْنَا بَلَی یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (فَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَایَ وَ أَنَا مَوْلَی الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ عَلِیٌّ (مَوْلَی مَنْ کُنْتُ مَوْلَاهُ اللَّهُمَّ وَالِ مَنْ وَالَاهُ وَ عَادِ مَنْ عَادَاهُ فَقَالَ أَنْتُمْ تَقُولُونَ ذَلِکَ قَالُوا نَعَمْ.
6.fa: امام علی (- ریاح‌بن‌حارث گوید: «در الرّحبه با امیرالمؤمنین (بودم که کاروانی در حال حرکت بودند تا به الرّحبه رسیدند سپس به‌سوی علی (آمدند و عرض کردند: «سلام برتو ای امیرالمؤمنین (». حضرت پرسید: «شما چه کسانی هستید»؟ گفتند: «ای امیرالمؤمنین (ما از موالیان شما هستیم». ریاح می‌گوید به علی (نگاه کردم دیدم آن حضرت خندید و فرمود: «شما کجا و قوم عرب کجا»؟ عرض کردند: «ما شنیدیم که رسول خدا (در روز غدیرخم دستت را گرفته و فرمود: «ای مردم آیا من به مؤمنان سزاوارتر از خودشان نیستم»؟ مسلمانان گفتند: «چرا ای رسول خدا». پیامبر (فرمود: «خداوند مولای من و مولای مؤمنان است و علی مولای کسی است که من مولای او هستم خدایا هرکس او را دوست دارد دوست بدار و هرکس با او دشمنی می‌کند دشمن بدار». حضرت علی (پرسید: «شما این چنین اعتقاد دارید»؟ گفتند: «بله».
6.en: Riyāḥ ibn al-Ḥārith said: I was in al-Raḥbah with the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) when a caravan approached, traveling until they knelt their mounts at al-Raḥbah. Then they walked until they came to ‘Alī (peace be upon him) and said, "Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings." He asked, "Who are the people?" They replied, "We are your loyal followers (mawālīka), O Commander of the Faithful." I looked at him and he was smiling, and he said, "How can that be, when you are an Arab people?" They replied, "We heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) say on the day of Ghadīr Khumm, while he was holding your hand, 'O people, am I not more worthy of the believers than their own selves?' We said, 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.' He then said, 'Allah is my Master (Mawlā) and I am the Master of the believers, and ‘Alī is the Master of whomever I am his Master. O Allah, befriend whoever befriends him and be hostile to whoever is hostile to him.'" He (‘Alī) then asked, "Do you say that?" They replied, "Yes."
6.book: Tafsīr Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 32
