This is the meaning of His saying: 'And [mention, O Muhammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant' (33:7). He mentioned the entirety of the prophets (AS), then highlighted the best of them by name, saying: 'And from you, O Muhammad' (33:7). He placed the Messenger of Allah (SAWA) first because he is the best of them. [He continued:] 'And from Noah, and Abraham, and Moses, and Jesus, son of Mary' (33:7). These five are the best of the prophets (AS), and the Messenger of Allah (SAWA) is the best of them. Then, after that, He took the covenant from the prophets (AS) to believe in the Messenger of Allah (SAWA) and to support the Commander of the Faithful (AS)."
7.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 5, p. 236; al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 246; al-Burhan

7.ar: الحسین (- الْحُسَیْنُ بْنُ عَلِیِّ بْنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (قَالَ بَیْنَمَا أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (جُلُوسٌ فِی مَسْجِدِهِ بَعْدَ وَفَاتِهِ (یَتَذَاکَرُونَ فَضْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (إِذْ دَخَلَ عَلَیْنَا حِبْرٌ مِنْ أَحْبَارِ یَهُودِ أَهْلِ الشَّامِ قَدْ قَرَأَ التَّوْرَاةَ وَ الْإِنْجِیلَ وَ الزَّبُورَ وَ صُحُفَ إِبْرَاهِیمَ (وَ الْأَنْبِیَاءِ (وَ عَرَفَ دَلَائِلَهُمْ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَیْنَا وَ جَلَسَ ثُمَّ لَبِثَ هُنَیْئَةً (هُنَیْهَةً) ثُمَّ قَالَ یَا أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ (مَا تَرَکْتُمْ لِنَبِیٍّ (دَرَجَةً وَ لَا لِمُرْسَلٍ فَضِیلَةً إِلَّا وَ قَدْ تَحَمَّلْتُمُوهَا لِنَبِیِّکُمْ فَهَلْ عِنْدَکُمْ جَوَابٌ إِنْ أَنَا سَأَلْتُکُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (... لَقَدْ ذَکَرَهُ اللَّهُ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی مَعَ الرُّسُلِ فَبَدَأَ بِهِ وَ هُوَ آخِرُهُمْ لِکَرَامَتِهِ (فَقَالَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ وَ إِذْ أَخَذْنا مِنَ النَّبِیِّینَ مِیثاقَهُمْ وَ مِنْکَ وَ مِنْ نُوح وَ قَالَ إِنَّا أَوْحَیْنا إِلَیْکَ کَما أَوْحَیْنا إِلی نُوحٍ وَ النَّبِیِّینَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَ النَّبِیُّونَ قَبْلَهُ فَبَدَأَ بِهِ وَ هُوَ آخِرُهُمْ وَ لَقَدْ فَضَّلَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَی جَمِیعِ الْأَنْبِیَاء (... وَ زَادَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ تَکْرِمَةً بِأَخْذِ مِیثَاقِهِ قَبْلَ النَّبِیِّینَ وَ أَخْذِ مِیثَاقِ النَّبِیِّینَ بِالتَّسْلِیمِ وَ الرِّضَا وَ التَّصْدِیقِ لَهُ فَقَالَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ وَ إِذْ أَخَذْنا مِنَ النَّبِیِّینَ مِیثاقَهُمْ وَ مِنْکَ وَ مِنْ نُوحٍ وَ إِبْراهِیم.
7.en: Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said: "While the companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) were sitting in his mosque after his passing, discussing the virtues of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), a scholar from the Jewish scholars of the Levant entered upon us. He had read the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, the Scrolls of Abraham (peace be upon him), and the prophets, and he knew their signs. He greeted us and sat down. He waited for a short while and then said: 'O nation of Muhammad! You have not left any rank of any prophet, nor any virtue of any messenger, but that you have attributed it to your Prophet. Do you have an answer if I were to ask you?' The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said to him: '...Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, mentioned him alongside the messengers, and He began with him even though he was the last of them, due to his honor. He, Majestic is His praise, said: "And [mention, O Muhammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah..." (33:7). And He said: "Indeed, We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], as We revealed to Noah and the prophets after him..." (4:163). Even though the prophets were before Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), He began with him, though he was the last of them. Allah has favored him over all the prophets... And Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, increased his honor by taking his covenant before the prophets, and by taking the covenant of the prophets to submit to him, to be pleased with him, and to believe in him. Thus, He, Majestic is His praise, said: "And [mention, O Muhammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham."'
7.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 54
7.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 16, p. 341; Irshad al-Qulub, Vol. 2, p. 406

7.ar: الباقر (- اخذ اللَّهُ مِیثَاقَهُ عَلَی نُوحٍ (وَ عَلَی النَّبِیِّینَ (أَنْ یَعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی وَ لَا یُشْرِکُوا بِهِ شَیْئاً وَ أَمَرَ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَ الْأَمْرِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ النَّهْیِ عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ وَ الْحَلَالِ وَ الْحَرَامِ وَ لَمْ یَفْرِضْ عَلَیْهِ أَحْکَامَ حُدُودٍ وَ لَا فَرَضَ مَوَارِیثَ فَهَذِهِ شَرِیعَتُه.
7.fa: امام باقر (- خداوند از نوح (و دیگر پیامبران، پیمان گرفته که خداوند تبارک‌وتعالی را بپرستند و چیزی را شریک او ندانند. به نماز و امر به نیکی و نهی از زشتی و توجّه به حلال و حرام، فرمان داده است و بر نوح (احکام حدود و واجبات مواریث را واجب نگردانید. و شریعت نوح (چنین بود.
7.en: God took a covenant from Noah and from the prophets that they should worship God, Blessed and Exalted is He, and not associate anything with Him. He commanded them to perform prayer, to enjoin good, to forbid evil, and to observe the lawful and the unlawful. He did not impose upon him [Noah] the laws of prescribed punishments (hudud), nor did He impose the laws of inheritance. This was his (Noah's) law (sharia).

7.ar: الصّادق (- مَا بَعَثَ اللَّهُ نَبِیّاً (مِنْ لَدُنْ آدَمَ (فَهَلُمَّ جَرّاً إِلَّا وَ یَرْجِعُ إِلَی الدُّنْیَا وَ یَنْصُرُ أَمِیرَالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهِ یَعْنِی بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ لَتَنْصُرُنَّ أَمِیرَالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُمْ فِی الذَّرِّ أَ أَقْرَرْتُمْ وَ أَخَذْتُمْ عَلی ذلِکُمْ إِصْرِی أَیْ عَهْدِی قالُوا أَقْرَرْنا قالَ اللَّهُ لِلْمَلَائِکَةِ فَاشْهَدُوا وَ أَنَا مَعَکُمْ مِنَ الشَّاهِدِینَ وَ هَذِهِ مَعَ الْآیَةِ الَّتِی فِی سُورَةِ الْأَحْزَابِ فِی قَوْلِهِ وَ إِذْ أَخَذْنا مِنَ النَّبِیِّینَ مِیثاقَهُمْ وَ مِنْکَ وَ مِنْ نُوح وَ الْآیَةُ الَّتِی فِی سُورَةِ الْأَعْرَافِ قَوْلُهُ وَ إِذْ أَخَذَ رَبُّکَ مِنْ بَنِی آدَمَ مِنْ ظُهُورِهِمْ ذُرِّیَّتَهُمْ قَدْ کُتِبَتْ هَذِهِ الثَّلَاثُ آیَاتٍ فِی ثَلَاثِ سُوَرٍ.
7.en: God has not sent a single prophet—from the time of Adam and onwards—but that he shall return to this world and assist the Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib). This is the meaning of His words: "You shall surely believe in him," meaning the Messenger of God, "and you shall surely assist him," meaning the Commander of the Faithful. Then, in the realm of the 'Dhar' (the primordial state), He said to them: "Do you affirm this, and do you take upon yourselves My burden—that is, My covenant—in this regard?" They replied: "We affirm it." God said to the angels: "Then bear witness, and I am with you among the witnesses." This is connected to the verse in Surah al-Ahzab: "And when We took from the prophets their covenant, and from you, and from Noah..." and the verse in Surah al-A'raf: "And when your Lord took from the children of Adam, from their loins, their descendants..." These three verses are linked, though they are recorded in three separate chapters.

7.ar: الرّسول (- عَنْ أَبِی سَعِیدٍ الْخُدْرِیِّ قَالَ: رَأَیْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (وَ سَمِعْتُهُ یَقُولُ یَا عَلِیُّ (مَا بَعَثَ اللَّهُ نَبِیّاً إِلَّا وَ قَدْ دَعَاهُ إِلَی وَلَایَتِکَ طَائِعاً أَوْ کَارِها.
7.fa: پیامبر (- ابوسعیدخدری گوید: پیامبر (را دیدم و از او شنیدم درحالی‌که می‌فرمود: ای علی (خداوند پیامبری را مبعوث نکرد مگر اینکه او را دعوت به ولایت تو کرد چه بخواهد و چه نخواهد.
7.en: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) and heard him saying: "O Ali, Allah did not send a prophet except that He called him to your wilayah (guardianship/allegiance), whether he was willing or unwilling."
7.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 56

7.ar: الرّسول (- عَنْ حُذَیْفَةَ بْنِ أَسِیدٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (مَا تَکَامَلَتِ النُّبُوَّةُ لِنَبِیٍّ فِی الْأَظِلَّةِ حَتَّی عُرِضَتْ عَلَیْهِ وَلَایَتِی وَ وَلَایَةُ أَهْلِ بَیْتِی وَ مَثُلُوا لَهُ فَأَقَرُّوا بِطَاعَتِهِمْ وَ وَلَایَتِهِم.
7.fa: پیامبر (- حذیفه گوید: رسول خدا (فرمود: «پیامبری هیچ پیامبری در عالم أظله تکمیل نشد مگر اینکه بر او ولایت من و ولایت اهل بیتم عرضه شد و تمثال آن‌ها برای آن پیامبر مجسم شد. پس اقرار به اطاعت و ولایت آن‌ها نمودند.
7.en: Hudhayfah ibn Asid reported that the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: "The prophethood of no prophet was completed in the realm of shadows (al-azillah) until my wilayah (guardianship/authority) and the wilayah of my Ahl al-Bayt were presented to him, and they were represented before him; so they acknowledged their obedience and their wilayah."

7.ar: الباقر (- إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی أَخَذَ مِیثَاقَ النَّبِیِّینَ عَلَی وَلَایَةِ عَلِیٍ (وَ أَخَذَ عَهْدَ النَّبِیِّینَ بِوَلَایَةِ عَلِی (.
7.fa: امام باقر (- خداوند تبارک‌وتعالی میثاق پیامبران را بر ولایت علی (و پیمان پیامبران را به ولایت علی (گرفت.
7.en: Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, took the covenant of the prophets regarding the wilaya (guardianship) of Ali, and took the pledge of the prophets to the wilaya of Ali.

7.ar: الباقر (- وَلَایَتُنَا وَلَایَةُ اللَّهِ الَّتِی لَمْ یَبْعَثْ نَبِیّاً قَطُّ إِلَّا بِهَا.
7.fa: امام باقر (- ولایت ما همان ولایت خداست، که هیچ پیامبری را جز به آن [و با ایمان به آن] نفرستاده است.
7.en: Our wilayah (guardianship/authority) is the very wilayah of Allah, through which He has never sent any prophet except by it [and by belief in it].

8.ar: الصّادق (- قَالَ الصَّادِقُ (: إِذَا سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَنْ صِدْقِهِ عَلَی أَیِّ وَجْهٍ قَالَهُ، فَیُجَازَی بِحَسَبِهِ، فَکَیْفَ یَکُونُ حَالُ الْکَاذِبِ؟
8.fa: امام صادق (- در آن هنگام از انسان راستگو پیرامون اینکه به چه شکلی راست گفته است، سؤال می‌شود و به همان اندازه، به او پاداش داده می‌شود، پس بنگرید که شخص دروغگو چگونه مؤاخذه می‌شود!
8.en: When the truthful person is asked about the manner in which he spoke the truth, he is rewarded accordingly; so how then will be the state of the liar?
